topics.title: Antigravity usage resolves model names and prices effort variants

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading Update button for Claude in f5's provider maintenance.

suggestion.reason: Cleanup with no visible behavior change.

topics.title: Desktop drops the unused Linux --class switch

suggestion.reason: Small settings consistency fix.

topics.summary: For grouped projects, Project settings uses the sidebar representative's identity for the preview, description and icon defaults, so the preview no longer shows a different checkout's icon.
topics.title: Grouped project settings show a consistent icon

suggestion.reason: Measurable connect-latency improvement on loaded hosts, if f5 has equivalent connect-time discovery.

topics.summary: Editor and SSH or Tailscale open-target discovery uses a 60 s stale-while-revalidate cache and runs concurrently on connect, so WebSocket connects don't block on slow probes.
topics.title: Client connects no longer wait on editor and SSH target discovery

suggestion.question: Should f5 add Kiro as a new (off-by-default) provider alongside its existing provider set?
suggestion.reason: A new provider capability built on ACP, which f5 already has. Kiro isn't in f5's provider list, so whether to adopt it is a product choice.

topics.summary: Adds a kiro driver built on the shared ACP adapter, with native steering, fork from a message and /compact. It is off by default and listed under Show more in Add provider.
topics.title: Kiro added as an Early Access ACP provider

suggestion.reason: f5 doesn't have the Tiptap rich text composer this change targets.

topics.summary: In the Tiptap rich text composer, typing a backtick, * or _ over a selection applies code or italic formatting instead of inserting literal markers.
topics.title: Wrapping a selection in backticks formats it as code in the rich composer

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for managed service updates. Without it, the shell's t3 command stays on an old runtime.

topics.summary: After a committed managed update, the server repoints the install-bin and PATH t3 links that point into this home's runtimes. Each link is replaced atomically, and user pins and other homes' links are kept.
topics.title: Self-update moves the t3 command to the new runtime

suggestion.reason: Data correctness fix in workspace file reads. The symptom can occur in f5.

topics.summary: Workspace file reads loop until all requested bytes arrive. Short reads on SMB, NFS or sshfs no longer open a silently truncated file.
topics.title: Files panel reads whole files on network filesystems

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong-branch checkouts in PR and worktree flows that f5 has.

topics.summary: Clone lookups for a pull request pass the PR URL's host to GitHub and Forgejo, so a same-named repository on the checkout's host is no longer used, which gave the wrong commit and upstream.
topics.title: PR checkout looks up the clone URL on the pull request's host

suggestion.reason: Prevents a running turn from being detached silently. f5 has the branch toolbar files.

topics.summary: While a turn runs, branches checked out in another worktree are disabled with a notice. Thread state is checked again before and after checkout, so a newer run isn't detached.
topics.title: Branch picker no longer interrupts a running turn

suggestion.reason: A UX improvement on the Usage page, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Provider summary rows on the Usage page sort by the displayed Cost or Tokens value, highest first. Chart series and day columns keep their stable order.
topics.title: Usage provider summaries are ranked by the selected metric

suggestion.reason: Fixes threads started from a PR not being linked to it in f5's PR hub.

topics.summary: Checkout drafts keep the PR URL and branch. The first successful send links the new thread to the PR, and explicit workspace changes clear the pending link.
topics.title: A thread started from a pull request links that PR

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix in ThreadLiveEventCoalescer, which f5 also has, for streaming failures during long tool output.

topics.summary: The live event coalescer replaces pending updates for the same thread, run and tool as they arrive and releases their buffer charge. Large tool-output bursts no longer cause LiveStreamBufferError.
topics.title: Tool output bursts are coalesced before they fill the live buffer

suggestion.reason: An unbounded wait on Stop can also happen in f5's Claude adapter. This is a one-line fix to reimplement outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: The wait for the Claude SDK to acknowledge an interrupt is capped at 10 seconds. After that, the query is closed and the turn settles as interrupted.
topics.title: Stopping a Claude turn no longer hangs without an acknowledgement

suggestion.reason: Small fix in composerDraftStore, a file f5 has.

topics.summary: An existing thread saved without model options no longer borrows options from the project or settings default. Before, an untouched follow-up could send options the thread never had.
topics.title: Composer keeps an optionless thread's model defaults

suggestion.reason: A small display-accuracy fix in the Claude provider.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter records only an explicit launch effort for subagents. Child threads no longer display an inherited effort they might not use.
topics.title: Claude subagents no longer show the parent's effort

suggestion.reason: Saves forge API quota that missing PRs waste every minute. Reimplement in f5's PR sync.

topics.summary: A not-found response puts the PR on the 15-minute retry cadence for active threads, and settled links stop periodic reads. An explicit refresh still reads immediately.
topics.title: PR sync stops reading missing pull requests every minute

suggestion.reason: A small keyboard UX fix for update dialogs in settings and desktop. Skip the relay install dialog part.

topics.summary: A DialogAction marker lets a dialog focus its enabled primary button when it opens. Update and install prompts opt in, so Enter confirms; generic and destructive confirmations keep Cancel focused.
topics.title: Update confirmation dialogs focus the primary action

suggestion.reason: Rewind was blocked in non-Git workspaces, and f5 has the same checkpoint and rewind surface. Reimplement in f5's checkpoint layers.

topics.summary: 'Edit from here' keeps conversation anchors when checkpoints have no file snapshot. The dialog offers file restore only for a ready snapshot. Rewind targets follow surviving runs, and discarded targets are rejected.
topics.title: Conversation-only rewind works in workspaces without Git

suggestion.reason: The upstream file is orchestration-v2, but the same receipt race can happen in f5's dispatcher. Check that f5's dispatcher has the same insertIfAbsent receipt path before reimplementing.

topics.summary: After commit, dispatch checks that the committed receipt belongs to the command's own thread. The losing command now fails instead of reporting the winner's success.
topics.title: A command id reused for two threads at once no longer succeeds for both

suggestion.reason: Client performance improvement. client-runtime doesn't exist in f5, so it would need reimplementing in f5's shell or store layer.

topics.summary: The environment shell state applies all thread deltas in a received batch together, instead of copying the state once per event.
topics.title: Shell state merges stream deltas once per received batch

suggestion.reason: Performance improvement in the Files panel, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Refreshes requested while a directory load is in flight share one follow-up load, instead of each queuing another full reload.
topics.title: Overlapping file tree refreshes are coalesced

suggestion.reason: Visible desktop and web UX improvement. Keep f5's own branding name.

topics.summary: The title no longer flashes 'T3 Code (Beta)' at startup. The renderer titles the window and browser tab after the open thread, and the desktop falls back to the app name only for a blank title.
topics.title: Window title shows the right app name and the open thread

suggestion.reason: Lets agents tell why a page failed in f5's desktop-hosted preview. Port only the desktop parts, not ServerBrowser.

topics.summary: preview_status and preview_snapshot include a loadError with the failed URL, error code and description. Desktop-rendered tabs forward main-frame failures, and a new navigation clears the error.
topics.title: Browser tools report why a page failed to load

suggestion.reason: Fixes Usage → Limits for custom Codex routes, which wrongly showed another account's limits or a misleading probe failure. f5 has the Codex provider and usage limits.

topics.summary: Codex publishes subscription quota only when the account needs OpenAI auth, is not an API-key account, and routing is confirmed to reach a native OpenAI endpoint. Otherwise it skips the quota RPC and the quota-derived workspace identity.
topics.title: Custom Codex providers no longer report another account's native quota

suggestion.reason: Fixes OpenCode rejecting requests with an invented 'medium' variant. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter, since packages/provider-* doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: Catalog models list only the variants they advertise. A saved variant is dropped at dispatch only when the catalog confirms it is unsupported. This covers chat, native commands and text generation.
topics.title: OpenCode models without reasoning variants no longer show a Reasoning menu
fix(mobile): text no longer clips in Android desktop windows on external displays (#19064)

suggestion.reason: Measurable Windows performance gain for every git call.

topics.summary: Git commands run with DETACHED_PROCESS when they can run without a console. This saves one conhost.exe and about 11 ms per git start on Windows.
topics.title: Windows git reads no longer start a console host

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for service-managed installs. The failure can happen when an older installer writes state next to a newer runtime.

topics.summary: At startup, the launcher accepts only an exact {protocol: 2, activeVersion} install record that has a valid SemVer and a complete runtime, and rewrites it as protocol 3. Before, a service with an older installer's record failed on every start.
topics.title: Service launcher adopts a compatible legacy protocol-2 install record

suggestion.reason: Fixes Changes counts that disagreed with the Diff panel, in f5's diff and git actions surfaces.

topics.summary: The Changes row reads the same comparison query as the Diff panel, with the remembered base and a shared session ignore-whitespace toggle. The +/- counts then match what the panel shows.
topics.title: Changes row counts match the Diff panel's comparison

suggestion.reason: f5 has the Grok provider, and the effort picker currently does nothing.

topics.summary: The Grok adapter sends the stored reasoningEffort through session/set_model on ACP v1, or through the thought_level config option on newer protocols. Refused or unsupported values log a warning and don't fail the session.
topics.title: Grok applies the selected reasoning effort to ACP sessions

suggestion.reason: Memory reliability fix in effect-acp, which exists in f5.

topics.summary: The unread raw notification backlog is capped at 32 entries and 16Mi characters, and always keeps the newest. The stream completes when the connection ends.
topics.title: Unread ACP raw notifications no longer pin hundreds of MiB

suggestion.reason: Refactor with no behavior change.

topics.summary: Moves model cache invalidation out of ws.ts into ProviderRegistry.invalidateModelCaches. Behavior doesn't change.
topics.title: Provider registry owns explicit model cache invalidation

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for service-managed server updates, which f5 appears to have (service launcher topics are open). Without it, the service eventually fails to start after updates.

topics.summary: After a durable update commit, the launcher repoints the service definition's program version and reloads the service manager. A pruned old runtime then no longer breaks the next service start. Reconciliation retries are added, under a selection lock.
topics.title: Remote updates point the systemd/launchd service at the committed runtime

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken or missing agent questions for Antigravity and other ACP agents in f5. Upstream tests live in orchestration-v2, so the fix needs to be redone in f5's ACP adapter and pending-input state.

topics.summary: Antigravity chat now receives the adapter's form-elicitation capability. ACP forms become questions, including titled and items.enum multi-selects, and keep exact option values. Answers come back as declared arrays, booleans or numbers. Invalid required answers cancel, and unsupported forms are dec…
topics.title: ACP form questions keep multi-select choices and return typed answers; Antigravity forms enabled

suggestion.reason: Gives a clearer error for a real Antigravity failure mode in f5's provider settings. It is small and self-contained in AntigravityDriver, which exists in the fork.

topics.summary: When Antigravity model discovery fails with the 'python-socks is required to use a SOCKS proxy' signature, the refresh error shows fixed explanatory text instead of a generic failure. Unknown diagnostics stay generic, and the catalog is preserved.
topics.title: Antigravity model refresh explains a missing python-socks dependency

suggestion.reason: Cuts redundant PR lookups and stops subagent threads staying unsettled. Reimplement in f5's settlement layer.

topics.summary: Hidden subagent threads wait until their parent settles, is archived or is deleted, then settle once idle. They skip their own inactivity and PR lookups, and manual parent settlement drains them.
topics.title: Subagent threads settle with their parent instead of sweeping on their own

suggestion.reason: A user-visible improvement to threads and snooze. It only applies when the user snoozes, so nothing new happens automatically.

topics.summary: An explicit snooze can now defer a thread with a pending question, and the question stays answerable. A newer question wakes the thread, and answering or waking it clears the snooze. Approvals and subagent requests still block snoozing.
topics.title: Threads waiting on a question can be snoozed

suggestion.reason: Fixes understated tokens and cost on the Usage page. f5 has the Usage surface.

topics.summary: Records with the same dedupe key are merged by taking the maximum of each token channel and of the cost, instead of keeping the first, often partial, copy. Adds a v6 scan cache, and live v4/v5 entries are reparsed once.
topics.title: Usage no longer undercounts Claude subagent output

suggestion.reason: Fixes an accidental-resume bug in the composer.

topics.summary: Stop is disabled while pending, and an inert Stopped control holds its position so repeat clicks don't hit Resume. Retry is allowed after 10 s. Stop stays at the right edge while answering questions.
topics.title: Stop shows a pending state and repeat clicks no longer resume

suggestion.reason: Codex bug fix that prevents losing a conversation, and it applies to f5.

topics.summary: When Codex reports 'already has an active writer', the turn fails with a clear message telling the user to quit the other Codex client. Before, the conversation was silently replaced.
topics.title: Codex threads open in another client are no longer silently replaced

topics.title: iOS Agent Activity widget shows agents instead of a blank tile

suggestion.reason: f5 has PR watches. Stale wakes start pointless turns. Reimplement outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: Before a queued PR-watch notification starts, it is checked again. If the watch stopped, the link went away, the head changed or the PR merged or closed, the run is cancelled and the next queued message runs.
topics.title: Queued PR watch wakes are dropped once the watch is stale

suggestion.reason: Small performance gain for subagent tooltips with large results. Output is unchanged.

topics.summary: subagentDetailPreview stops normalizing once it has enough characters for the 280-character preview, instead of processing the whole result.
topics.title: Subagent previews process only the visible prefix

suggestion.reason: A measurable git performance fix for worktrees and checkpoints.

topics.summary: After createWorktree, the git index is refreshed once, with a timeout. Files are no longer 'racily clean', so checkpoint captures and status polls stop re-reading the whole checkout.
topics.title: New worktrees refresh their index once, so captures and status stop re-hashing files

suggestion.reason: This fixes misleading tool status for the Cursor provider in f5.

topics.summary: When a Cursor turn finishes, tools that never got a completion event close as interrupted instead of completed, so denied reads no longer show as successful.
topics.title: Cursor tool calls without a completion close as interrupted

suggestion.reason: This is the producer half of a series. The consumer, #21461, is not merged, so there is no user-visible behavior yet.

topics.summary: The OpenCode adapter publishes pendingBackgroundWork in stream order and refreshes ancestor threads. The consumer is in the follow-up #21461.
topics.title: OpenCode publishes ordered pending-work snapshots

suggestion.reason: Fixes Update for providers installed with mise, such as on Omarchy. Reimplement it in f5's provider maintenance resolver, since upstream's version is in packages/provider-*.

topics.summary: When mise owns a provider install, Update runs mise upgrade for tools requested as latest, and mise latest supplies the offered version. Pinned tools stay manual. This covers Claude, Codex, Grok, Muse, OpenCode and Pi.
topics.title: Providers installed with mise update through mise

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: The mobile image cache is keyed by asset identity instead of the signed URL.
topics.title: Mobile images stop re-downloading when their URL is re-signed

suggestion.reason: Only applies when the same repository is on several connected servers under All servers.

topics.summary: When one repository is on several connected servers, the PR list falls back to another owner if the preferred server's host read fails. It remembers host availability and retries preferred servers on refresh.
topics.title: All servers PR list falls back to a server that can read the repository

suggestion.reason: This fixes command output rendering in the timeline, which f5 shares.

topics.summary: SGR 58 underline colour is consumed and ignored, and colon sub-parameters on codes other than 38 and 48 are parsed correctly. Bold and colour now stay in effect.
topics.title: Underline styles and colours no longer scramble command output colours

suggestion.reason: This fixes the GitLab check status in f5's PR hub.

topics.summary: The status mapping matches GitLab's spelling 'canceling', so these pipelines map to cancelled and PR watches stop treating them as in flight.
topics.title: GitLab pipelines being canceled show as cancelled, not pending

suggestion.reason: A small desktop packaging fix for a real failure. f5 has the same build script.

topics.summary: Adds the NSCalendars usage descriptions (full access, write-only and legacy) to the macOS Info.plist, so EventKit commands run from terminals or agents get a permission prompt instead of failing.
topics.title: macOS desktop declares Calendar access for hosted commands

suggestion.reason: Users on non-US macOS layouts can't type @, | or brackets in the terminal. Apply it if f5's terminal key encoding has the same Alt handling.

topics.summary: On macOS, Option chords that produce a single character send that character (for example German Option+L for @) instead of an ESC-prefixed Alt sequence. This matches Terminal.app and iTerm2.
topics.title: Terminal types macOS Option-layer characters

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken media in the PR hub for SSO organizations and forks. Reimplement in f5's forge layer.

topics.summary: Asset requests carry the PR's repository. When GitHub returns an SSO sign-in page, the server renders the upload through the Markdown API in that repository's context and fetches the signed URL, with caching.
topics.title: PR images and videos load from SAML SSO and fork repositories

suggestion.reason: A visible terminal fix, if f5 uses the Ghostty renderer.

topics.summary: The Ghostty renderer puts row edges on whole device pixels and clears the full row, so fractional zoom leaves no cursor edge lines.
topics.title: Terminal cursor no longer leaves faint lines when it blinks off

suggestion.reason: Affects only the mobile app.

topics.summary: Patches react-native-webview on Android so horizontal gestures stay with the WebView.
topics.title: Android keeps diagonal horizontal swipes inside HTML blocks

suggestion.question: Does f5 support driving a local background service from the desktop with Local environment turned off?
suggestion.reason: Fixes dead-end 'No SSH route' errors in Open in and Reveal for a same-machine service. f5 has a desktop and remote environments.

topics.summary: When the desktop drives a same-machine background service through a saved environment, Open in, Reveal in file manager and the file preview's editor picker run locally instead of falling back to SSH deep links.
topics.title: Open in runs locally for a background service sharing the desktop's T3 home

suggestion.reason: Fixes delegated-task status after a cancel. Reimplement inside f5's orchestrator and MCP layers.

topics.summary: task_cancel records cancelledRunId with the child's stop. Finished work then settles as interrupted instead of completed, so the parent task no longer stays running. Published results and failures are kept.
topics.title: Cancelling a background-only delegated task reports it interrupted
docs: explain how to enable the context window indicator (#21678)

suggestion.reason: Only the mobile app changes.

topics.summary: The Android composer handles hardware Return like iOS: Return sends, Shift+Return adds a new line, and Ctrl+Return sends the other way.
topics.title: Android composer sends with Return on a hardware keyboard
test(scripts): identify the Windows native probe by executable (#21774)

suggestion.reason: This fixes video display in the files panel.

topics.summary: The Files panel video preview overrides the default 16:9 box, so portrait and square videos fit at their own proportions.
topics.title: File preview videos keep their own aspect ratio

suggestion.reason: A small usage improvement for providers f5 supports. f5 must reimplement it outside the packages/provider-* code.

topics.summary: Decodes Grok's currentPeriod.start and Cursor's billingCycleStart to set windowDurationMins. Usage → Limits can then show the pace icon and the even-spend marker for both.
topics.title: Grok and Cursor usage limits show pace and the even-spend line

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix in desktop environment capture, which affects whether provider CLIs are found.

topics.summary: The desktop shell-environment probe ignores stderr instead of piping it unread, so startup scripts that fill the pipe no longer stall until the timeout and drop CLI directories from PATH.
topics.title: Noisy login shells no longer block desktop PATH capture

suggestion.reason: A timeline UX fix for a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: After layout and initial output settle, expanding a work row near the composer reveals its output. The reveal holds until the list grows, and manual scrolling cancels it.
topics.title: Expanded work rows behind the composer scroll into view

suggestion.reason: Reliability and performance fix for PR sync polling. It needs reimplementing outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: For an open GitHub PR with an unchanged updatedAt, the last known mergeability is kept when GitHub briefly reports unknown. This avoids extra persisted updates and repeated stack reads.
topics.title: Transient GitHub 'unknown' mergeability no longer churns PR sync

suggestion.reason: A git action bug that can lead users to create a duplicate repository. It applies to f5's git status.

topics.summary: hasPrimaryRemote is true when any remote exists, not only origin. Repos cloned with --origin github no longer get 'Publish repository', which created a new hosted repo.
topics.title: A repository whose only remote isn't named origin gets Push and Create PR

suggestion.reason: Composer display bug that can occur in f5.

topics.summary: On narrow windows, the unfocused single-line composer preview renders citations, context references and file mentions as chips instead of raw serialized markup.
topics.title: Collapsed composer renders citation chips instead of serialized links

suggestion.reason: Fixes empty threads after ACP session import, which f5 has. The upstream code is in orchestration-v2, so it must be reimplemented in f5's layers.

topics.summary: Importing an ACP session reads the native session snapshot from session/load and stores it as run-less history, with thoughts as reasoning items. The imported thread no longer opens empty.
topics.title: Imported ACP sessions show their native history

suggestion.reason: UX improvement in settings and thread management, which f5 has. It uses an existing delete capability.

topics.summary: Adds a Delete action next to Unarchive in Settings → Archive. Both are icon buttons with tooltips and share the existing confirmation, which now names the thread, and the existing error handling.
topics.title: Delete archived threads from Settings → Archive

suggestion.reason: Fixes a settings bug that silently replaced the default model.

topics.summary: Settings no longer write a substitute provider's model when the user changes effort. The row keeps the saved model, notes when its provider is off or unavailable, and hides effort until the provider can run.
topics.title: Changing default model effort keeps the saved model

suggestion.reason: Prevents unintended cleanup sweeps from settings. f5 has storage cleanup settings, and its defaults are unchanged.

topics.summary: Turning on a retention rule opens an age draft instead of saving 8 days at once. The age is saved on Enter or blur, and Escape or switching off discards it. This avoids starting cleanup sweeps with an age the user didn't pick.
topics.title: Retention age isn't saved until committed

suggestion.reason: Add-project clone bug that can occur in f5. Reimplement without client-runtime.

topics.summary: On the clone confirm step, a folder picked with Open in Finder is resolved as the clone destination and the clone starts. Before, the empty folder was added as a project and nothing was cloned.
topics.title: Picking the clone destination in the file manager starts the clone

suggestion.reason: A timeline readability improvement for Claude output. f5 has ChatMarkdown and thread find.

topics.summary: A remark transform turns Claude's explanatory-style ★ Insight box-drawing fences into titled Insight callouts in assistant messages. Code, user messages and plans stay literal, and thread find indexes the insight body without the fences.
topics.title: Claude ★ Insight blocks render as callouts

suggestion.reason: A thread showing Input with no visible question is a high-impact symptom. If f5 pages its history, it needs reimplementing in f5's projection layer.

topics.summary: The thread snapshot window keeps the rows of pending questions and approvals, so their answer panel shows even after the run has pushed them out of the newest turns.
topics.title: Open questions and approvals stay in the loaded thread window

suggestion.reason: Fixes a missing prompt and functions for macOS Bash users in f5's terminal.

topics.summary: On macOS the integrated terminal starts bash with -l, so ~/.bash_profile loads, as it does in Terminal.app and VS Code.
topics.title: macOS Bash terminals start as login shells

suggestion.reason: Preview browser fix that stops page payloads from leaking into status and agent context.

topics.summary: Load reports, preview status, tab lists and snapshots shorten data: URLs to their media type, such as data:text/html,…, instead of echoing the payload.
topics.title: Preview status and snapshots hide data: page contents

suggestion.reason: This is a keyboard UX fix for f5's preview browser.

topics.summary: The desktop forwards preview.focusUrl out of a focused preview page, so mod+L focuses the address bar and selects its text.
topics.title: mod+L focuses the browser address bar from a focused page

suggestion.reason: User-visible bug fix in the diff panel, which f5 has. The selection is already stored per thread, and the reset discards it.

topics.summary: Removes the reset that sent the Diff panel back to Changes on navigation. Each thread now keeps its selected Uncommitted or turn comparison after a return from Settings or another thread. The workaround exceptions in panel actions and commit-link handling are removed too.
topics.title: Diff panel keeps its selected comparison across navigation

suggestion.reason: Makes full-screen html_render pages readable. f5 has html_render frames in the timeline.

topics.summary: HtmlRenderDialog caps the width at 1176px and sizes the frame to the content height. Zoom now reflows the page width instead of using CSS zoom.
topics.title: Full-screen HTML pages fit their content and zoom by reflowing
fix(mobile): iOS terminal's Attach visible output clears the home indicator (#22418)

suggestion.reason: The symptom can occur in f5's queue and usage-limit handling. Reimplement in f5's orchestrator, since upstream orchestration-v2 doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: The usage-limit queue hold now looks only at runs on the limited provider. A successful turn on another provider no longer releases queued messages into a limit that is still active, where each failed and switched the thread back.
topics.title: A limited provider's queue stays held after another provider's turn succeeds

suggestion.reason: Fixes commit message, title and PR text generation failing for OpenCode users who kept the default model.

topics.summary: The default OpenCode text generation model changes from openai/gpt-5, which many users cannot access, to opencode/big-pickle. Text-generation sessions keep read permission because OpenCode Zen refuses free-model requests that carry no tools.
topics.title: OpenCode text generation defaults to Big Pickle

suggestion.reason: This fixes the question card for the Pi provider, which f5 supports.

topics.summary: When a Pi select, editor or input dialog has no message or placeholder, its title becomes the question under a generic 'Question' header instead of appearing twice.
topics.title: Pi extension dialogs show their title once

suggestion.reason: PR hub bug fix. On large repos some people can't be requested as reviewers, and GitLab reviewer requests can't be removed. Reimplement in f5's PR layers instead of client-runtime.

topics.summary: When the first page of 100 candidates isn't everyone, typing in the reviewer menu also searches the host. GitLab lists the MR's requested reviewers first, so those requests can be removed.
topics.title: Reviewer menu searches past the first page and keeps GitLab's requested reviewers

suggestion.reason: A trivial performance improvement on a hot git status path. Cheap to port.

topics.summary: Drops a redundant toSorted before the final sort in local git status reads.
topics.title: Working-tree file list is sorted once per status read

suggestion.reason: This fixes the git context for generated text, and it stops Git from running repository-configured textconv commands.

topics.summary: The staged and range diffs used for text generation pass --no-textconv, so the model sees the committed lines and textconv commands are not run.
topics.title: Generated PR and commit text reads source diffs, not textconv output
test(server): stopped-queue steering test no longer races queue promotion (#22529)
test(server): launcher PATH lookup test no longer drops the Windows drive letter (#22534)

suggestion.reason: A search bug that also occurs in f5's threads with citations. Porting needs a migration.

topics.summary: Messages store a readable search_text with citation links decoded, and a migration backfills it. Search uses that text, so phrases in quotes match and hidden prefix and suffix context no longer do.
topics.title: Thread search finds phrases inside quotes and their comments

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop reliability bug: quit can leave an orphaned backend holding the database.

topics.summary: The quit stop timeout now covers the SIGTERM grace plus the SIGKILL wait. A backend that is slow to shut down is killed instead of being left running and holding the database.
topics.title: Quit no longer orphans a backend that is slow to stop

suggestion.question: Does f5 queue delegated-task completion notices as turns on the parent thread, so this model reversion can happen?
suggestion.reason: An unexpected model switch is a user-visible bug if f5 queues delegated completion notices. The fix needs reimplementing outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: A delegated-task completion notice that waits in the queue starts on the thread's current model, instead of switching the thread back to the model it had when the notice was queued.
topics.title: Queued delegated completions keep a newer model choice

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong context usage for ACP providers (Grok, Antigravity, Claude ACP). The meter and provider switching both show the symptom in f5.

topics.summary: Only usage_update (used/size) sets context usage now. Idle state_update usage totals, which add up tokens across the turn's model requests, no longer replace context size or drop the reported window. This fixes the meter and the false 'insufficient context allowance' failures on provider switches.
topics.title: ACP turn token totals no longer overwrite context usage and window size

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop SnapShot bug on macOS: Chromium and Electron apps captured a helper strip instead of their content window.

topics.summary: The macOS active-window lookup returns all of the frontmost app's layer-0 windows. It skips transparent windows and thin untitled helper strips, so SnapShots of Chrome, Zed and Electron apps capture the content window.
topics.title: macOS SnapShot skips helper strips and transparent windows

topics.reason: F5 uses classic OpenCode history without the affected compaction decoder.

suggestion.reason: This fixes a provider compatibility bug: checkpoint rollback breaks on newer OpenCode.

topics.summary: History page responses are normalized so that compactions missing 'recent' still decode. Before, rollback on OpenCode 2.1.2 aborted.
topics.title: OpenCode 2.1 compaction history decodes, so rollback works

suggestion.reason: Prevents running turns from failing with 'event stream closed unexpectedly'. The same thing can happen in f5.

topics.summary: While a thread has a blocking run, the orchestrator rejects a change of provider instance, or a selection that releases the session, with a 'wait and retry' error. MCP maps that error to invalid_request.
topics.title: Switching provider instances during a running turn is refused instead of failing the turn

suggestion.reason: This is a Claude fork bug that can happen in f5's Claude adapter. Reimplement it outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: forkSession is no longer limited to the current cwd, so the SDK finds the source transcript in the Claude home even after the project's workspace root moves.
topics.title: Forking a Claude thread works after the project root changes

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading provider-update failure for OpenCode users with an external Server URL. f5 has OpenCode provider maintenance.

topics.summary: When the CLI updates but a configured localhost opencode serve still reports the old version, Update now says to restart the local OpenCode server. Before, it said an outdated version was still detected. The launch notification logic accounts for this case.
topics.title: OpenCode update tells the user to restart a still-running local server

suggestion.reason: A git and worktree PR-status bug that can occur in f5. A wrong merged state can settle threads.

topics.summary: When the upstream matches the recorded gh-merge-base, the PR lookup treats it as a base and searches by the branch's own name. Threads no longer show, or settle on, a dev→main release PR.
topics.title: Worktrees cut from a non-default base no longer show the base's PR

suggestion.reason: Fixes a composer bug where Submit looked enabled but did nothing. f5 has the same question-card flow.

topics.summary: The composer treats a pending question answer as its own kind of submit. It skips provider-turn guards such as no provider, loading, a send in flight or reconnecting, so Submit and Enter no longer do nothing silently. Attachment, connection and scope blockers still apply.
topics.title: Question answers submit even when normal sends are blocked
fix(mobile): single-comment PR discussions say "1 comment", not "1 comments" (#22926)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a provider update loop that always fails for Windows Chocolatey users. Port into f5's provider maintenance layer.

topics.summary: On Windows, Claude under Chocolatey paths is treated as Chocolatey-owned. The latest version comes from choco search, and the card shows choco upgrade instead of running a claude update that always fails.
topics.title: Chocolatey Claude installs stay manual-only and compare against choco

suggestion.reason: A visible timer bug in threads and the sidebar.

topics.summary: When an agent message auto-drains from the queue, it gets the original workStartedAt, so the working timer doesn't reset mid-task. Explicit queue starts, user sends and resumes still start a fresh clock.
topics.title: Agent continuations keep the working timer's start

suggestion.reason: The fix is in upstream's server headless-Chrome preview, which policy says does not apply. f5 keeps its desktop-hosted preview.

topics.summary: Removes the returnByValue option from the preview evaluate contract, and ServerBrowserPage always evaluates by value. Object results then come back as data instead of {"value":"Object"}.
topics.title: preview_evaluate always returns results by value (server headless browser)

suggestion.reason: A user-visible capability in the desktop preview browser, which f5 has. It is Electron-hosted, not the server headless browser.

topics.summary: Adds a find bar to Electron-rendered preview tabs: search as you type, an active/total count, Enter and Shift+Enter navigation, and Escape to close. Works through PreviewManager findInPage IPC and a ⋮ menu entry.
topics.title: Cmd+F finds text on the page in the integrated browser

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for WSL server startup.

topics.summary: When no port is configured under WSL, startup checks Windows netstat listeners and picks a port that Windows localhost forwarding can reach.
topics.title: WSL servers avoid ports already used by Windows

suggestion.reason: Fixes timeline noise for Claude users who run plugins, which also applies to f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter drops informational notices at notice level that start with 'Stop says: ' and don't prevent continuation. Warnings and blocking notices are still shown.
topics.title: Passive Claude Stop-hook summaries no longer show as warnings after every turn
fix(mobile): subscription widget no longer expires on a window that already reset (#22993)

suggestion.reason: A desktop reliability fix for a relaunch failure. It is related to the ready topic pr-22572.

topics.summary: Stopping the backend now waits for the scoped process teardown to finish after a 7-second warning threshold. Quit no longer completes while the backend still holds the T3 home lock, which made the relaunch fail.
topics.title: Desktop quit waits for the local server to exit

suggestion.reason: Only affects upstream's Tiptap composer.

topics.summary: A ProseMirror plugin turns changed paragraphs with literal list markers into list nodes in the Tiptap composer.
topics.title: Composer converts list markers typed later into lists

suggestion.reason: Fixes a freeze in the timeline's reasoning rows, which f5 has. It overlaps the linear-time fix in pr-30038, so port the two together.

topics.summary: Collapsed and live reasoning previews parse at most 8,192 source characters and stop at 2,048 output characters, joining text runs once. Large reasoning traces no longer freeze the timeline when it renders.
topics.title: Collapsed reasoning previews parse a bounded prefix instead of the whole block

suggestion.reason: UX fix in the web Add Project command palette. The mobile part doesn't apply.

topics.summary: Owner-only GitHub input such as 'owner/' shows 'Repository name incomplete' instead of a generic lookup failure.
topics.title: Add Project rejects an incomplete GitHub owner/ path

suggestion.reason: A small UX clarity fix in the timeline's usage-limit notice. The mobile part does not apply.

topics.summary: The retry-time notice in the timeline appends the viewer's IANA timezone, so the reset time is unambiguous when viewing a remote host.
topics.title: Usage-limit retry notice shows the viewer's timezone

suggestion.reason: Gives a clearer error and avoids clearing the current goal in Codex /goal.

topics.summary: Objectives over 4,000 characters are rejected before any goal request. The message gives the character count and limit, and the current goal is left unchanged instead of failing with a generic start error.
topics.title: Oversized Codex /goal objectives are rejected with a clear message

suggestion.reason: f5 has its own scheduler. This labeling fix applies to its fixed-time schedules; reimplement it without client-runtime.

topics.summary: The scheduled-task list returns the server timeZone, and fixed-time labels append a short zone (UTC, PDT, GMT+5:30), so remote clients don't read the time as their own local time.
topics.title: Fixed-time scheduled tasks show the short server timezone

suggestion.reason: Small ordering fix in the PR hub's Code tab.

topics.summary: Test ordering tries the longest dotted prefix that names a source file, so a.logic.test.ts sorts next to a.logic.ts instead of falling to the end.
topics.title: PR diffs list .logic.test.ts files beside their source

suggestion.reason: A one-line theme editor bug fix in a file f5 has.

topics.summary: handleHexChange in ThemeColorPicker appends alphaSuffix, as the RGB and HSV paths already do, so translucent roles stay translucent.
topics.title: Typing a hex value keeps a theme color's alpha

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance gain for desktop SnapShot on Linux.

topics.summary: The native capture helpers use DEFLATE level 2, which is still lossless. This cuts encode time sharply on large windows. Upstream measured about 1.9 s for the helper and 3 s for a full SnapShot on a 4K window before the change.
topics.title: Hyprland and KDE SnapShots encode PNGs faster
fix(mobile): Bitbucket and GitCafe approvals show as approved on the PR timeline (#23138)

suggestion.reason: Fixes terminal tab labels in f5's terminal manager.

topics.summary: normalizeChildCommandName no longer cuts at the first space, so tabs show 'Google Chrome' instead of 'Google'.
topics.title: Terminal labels keep the whole name of a command with spaces
fix(mobile): disabled send button is readable in Material You dark (#23155)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong PR status indicator in thread rows.

topics.summary: ThreadRowLeadingStatus passes the thread's pullRequests and branchPullRequest to the linked-PR hook. Rows then show merged, closed or draft instead of a pending glyph.
topics.title: Command palette rows show the linked PR's known state

suggestion.reason: Fixes the desktop app freezing during preview browser cookie import.

topics.summary: readKeychainSecret uses the async keyring entry, so the keychain prompts during browser cookie import no longer freeze every desktop window.
topics.title: Chrome cookie import reads the keychain off the main thread on macOS

topics.reason: Only affects tooling for mobile app store screenshots.

suggestion.reason: Only affects tooling for mobile app store screenshots.

topics.summary: The mobile-showcase script fully decodes each PNG during validation.
topics.title: Mobile store screenshot validator rejects corrupt PNGs

suggestion.reason: Fixes data loss in theme settings for CJK theme names.

topics.summary: Names whose slug comes out empty get a theme-<hash> id instead of custom-theme, so a second theme no longer overwrites the first.
topics.title: Themes with non-Latin names get distinct, stable ids
fix(server): generated commit messages use source patches (#23164)

suggestion.reason: Prevents silent loss of a provider credential in ProviderInstanceCard, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Disables rename and the plain-text toggle for redacted stored secrets, and adds a hint to enter a new value. Before, either action silently erased the provider's API key.
topics.title: Saved sensitive provider variables can't be renamed or unlocked into an empty value

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stale write in the thread header that f5 also has.

topics.summary: The rename commit compares against the title captured when editing began. An untouched edit is then a no-op and doesn't restore an old title.
topics.title: Untouched header rename no longer overwrites a newer title

suggestion.reason: A measurable SQLite performance gain for agent thread reads. Reimplement it in f5's projection store.

topics.summary: getTimelinePage reads all payloads on a page through a single json_each join instead of one SQLite query per item, which was 50–100 queries per read.
topics.title: t3_thread_read loads a page's item payloads in one query

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing browser traces in Diagnostics.

topics.summary: decodeOtlpTraceRecords treats missing status, events, links, attributes and scope as empty. Valid batches are no longer dropped from the local trace file and Diagnostics.
topics.title: Browser OTLP traces with omitted empty fields are recorded

suggestion.reason: Fixes content search breaking on large workspaces.

topics.summary: A refresh that outlasts the 15 s wait no longer invalidates the live index. The finder keeps answering from its previous index, so content search keeps working on large or slow workspaces.
topics.title: Search index survives a refresh timeout

topics.reason: The fix depends on upstream's per-environment auth scopes, which f5 does not have.

suggestion.reason: The fix depends on upstream's per-environment auth scopes, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Update all and Update everything include only connected environments whose session has the providers:manage scope.
topics.title: Bulk provider updates skip environments without providers:manage

suggestion.reason: This fixes a bug in importing agent sessions.

topics.summary: The 100,000-record limit now applies to each transcript instead of one shared allowance. Valid conversations are no longer skipped after earlier files use it up.
topics.title: Session import applies the record limit to each transcript

suggestion.reason: A small UX fix for remote environment connections, which f5 has (SSH and saved environments). It restores a retry action that was missing during backoff.

topics.summary: While a paired environment reconnects, the composer banner shows a 'Retry now' button that runs the existing retry command. A first connection still hides the button, and offline or error states keep 'Reconnect'.
topics.title: Reconnecting environment banner offers Retry now

suggestion.reason: Fixes leaked provider processes when switching instances, in f5's provider handling.

topics.summary: Immediate sends use the provider switch plan's release list. The old instance's session and process are detached once it has no background work, and the send is refused while work remains.
topics.title: Sending to another provider instance releases the previous session
docs(mcp): document existing recurring-task tools (#23199)

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong file chips in chat Markdown, which f5 renders.

topics.summary: An implicit slashed inline-code reference with a :line suffix now needs a file extension or a known extensionless name to become a file chip. Explicit ./ paths and authored links behave as before.
topics.title: Spreadsheet shorthand like I/W217:220 stays inline code instead of a file chip

suggestion.reason: A measurable storage and write performance gain. Port only if f5 has the index and no query uses it, and renumber the migration for f5.

topics.summary: A migration drops idx_orch_events_correlation_id, which no query used, cutting write cost and database size on every event insert.
topics.title: Drop the unused orchestration event correlation index

suggestion.reason: This fixes a provider bug: the first message after importing a Claude session fails.

topics.summary: Imported Claude conversations with an existing transcript are marked as opened, so the first follow-up uses resume. It no longer fails with 'Session ID … is already in use.'
topics.title: Imported Claude sessions resume on their first turn
fix(mobile): cap live work-log summaries for long approval prompts (#23227)
fix(mobile): keep reduced-motion views visible and aligned (#23230)

suggestion.reason: Small settings input fix for IME users.

topics.summary: The project-name input ignores keydown while composing, so confirming CJK candidates no longer saves a partial name and blurs the field.
topics.title: Project name edits ignore Enter during IME composition

topics.reason: The change lives in the cloud boot service that backs the T3 Connect background host.

suggestion.question: Does f5 ship the pinned-runtime background launch agent installed by t3 update, outside T3 Connect?
suggestion.reason: The change lives in the cloud boot service that backs the T3 Connect background host.

topics.summary: After t3 update, the launch agent PATH points at the new pinned runtime directory instead of the replaced one. Agent shells then resolve t3 to the current build.
topics.title: macOS background service PATH names the updated runtime

suggestion.reason: User-visible bug in queue and steer. Reimplement in f5's orchestration layer.

topics.summary: Promote-to-steer uses the queued run's model selection instead of the thread's old one, so the answer comes from the provider the user picked.
topics.title: Steer on a queued message keeps the model picked for it
fix(mobile): use loaded branch for untouched worktree base (#23241)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a false 'Action failed' in the git Create PR flow, which f5 has.

topics.summary: After createChangeRequest succeeds, a failed findOpenPr lookup (502, rate limit, CLI timeout) is logged and treated as an empty lookup. The action no longer reports failure for a PR that already exists.
topics.title: Created PR is reported as created when the follow-up lookup fails

suggestion.reason: Fixes a missing user message in the timeline. f5's session-logic.ts has the same folding logic. Skip the mobile parts.

topics.summary: An async answer folds into its question card only when both belong to the same run. Answers that start a later run stay visible in the timeline and searchable in Find.
topics.title: Async answers that start a later run show as their own message

topics.reason: F5’s OpenCode adapter does not expose native steering.

suggestion.reason: An OpenCode provider bug that f5 can hit. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter.

topics.summary: steerTurn now sends the same agent, variant and system prompt as startTurn. Steering no longer drops OpenCode back to the build agent, which can edit files during a Plan turn, and no longer loses T3's runtime instructions.
topics.title: OpenCode steers keep the turn's agent, variant and system instructions

suggestion.reason: Stale-listing bug in the add-project picker. Reimplement in f5's own state layer.

topics.summary: The filesystem browse query revalidates when it mounts again, so folders created outside the app show up when the Add project picker reopens.
topics.title: Reopening a folder picker refreshes its listing

suggestion.reason: This fixes a provider bug: skills went missing and the Cursor probe failed.

topics.summary: Cursor skill discovery charges its traversal budget only for directories it can recurse into, and caps file stats with a separate limit. Large artifacts folders no longer use up the budget and fail the probe.
topics.title: Cursor supporting files no longer hide sibling skills

suggestion.reason: Fixes a missing-provider symptom in os-jank.ts, which exists in the fork.

topics.summary: When the first login shell probe times out, it is retried once with a 20 s timeout before provider environments are built. Providers are then no longer reported missing until a restart.
topics.title: Server recovers PATH after a slow login shell probe

suggestion.reason: Trivial visual alignment fix in the snooze dialog.

topics.summary: The date column gap changes from 1.5 to 2 to match the time label.
topics.title: Custom snooze Date and Time fields line up

suggestion.reason: Fixes a terminal UX overlap that can occur in f5's terminal.

topics.summary: Single-terminal split, new and close controls sit in a row above the terminal instead of floating over it, in both the right panel and the drawer.
topics.title: Terminal controls no longer cover the first line
perf(ci): skip PR vouch jobs for ordinary comments (#23387)

suggestion.reason: Clearer agent-facing errors in preview contracts that exist in f5.

topics.summary: Invalid preview URL errors list the accepted forms and say how to open a blank tab. Invalid locator and CSS selector errors include usage guidance.
topics.title: Preview tools explain invalid URLs and locators

suggestion.reason: f5 has source control settings and forges, and this is a clearer error for a misconfigured gh, fj or tea.

topics.summary: Source-control discovery keeps the install hint only when the executable is missing. Otherwise it names the failed probe command and whether it timed out or exited with a status.
topics.title: A slow or broken hosting CLI is no longer told to install itself

topics.reason: Policy classes webhook triggers as relay-cloud.

suggestion.reason: Policy classes webhook triggers as relay-cloud.

topics.summary: An exists filter on a [] path now matches a nonempty array of objects, such as an issue's labels.
topics.title: Webhook exists filters match wildcard arrays of objects

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale branch labels in the git/composer surfaces f5 shares.

topics.summary: The server watches each subscribed checkout's HEAD file, including linked worktrees, and refreshes git status when HEAD changes. Branch switches made in the terminal then update the composer and Thread details branch labels right away, not on the next window focus.
topics.title: Branch labels update after terminal checkouts

suggestion.reason: Usage bug fix for Claude accounts routed through CLIProxy, if f5 has that integration.

topics.summary: The CLIProxy usage decoder keeps the spend and extra_usage fields, so the Claude monthly spending budget is no longer stripped before the usage mapper reads it.
topics.title: Claude monthly spend survives usage refreshes through CLIProxy

suggestion.reason: Fixes a repeated password prompt on SSH environments.

topics.summary: Agent signing failures, such as 1Password or Secretive refusing while the Mac is locked, end the reconnect instead of opening SSH Password Required. Before, the dialog reopened every few minutes.
topics.title: SSH stops asking for a password when the agent can't sign

suggestion.reason: A test-only change.

topics.summary: Replay testkits use scoped temp directories, so test runs stop leaving folders behind.
topics.title: Replay tests delete their temp directories

topics.reason: F5 has no shared-session child attachment/unload lifecycle; Codex turn completion keeps its session ready, and native child notifications are excluded from app-thread projections.

suggestion.reason: Fixes delegated-task replies that are lost. Delegation is a thread surface f5 has.

topics.summary: When a completed Codex parent settles, each native thread is checked under its owning thread's attachment lock before unloading. Attached delegated children keep their subscription, so their replies show and their runs complete.
topics.title: Delegated children keep replies after their parent settles

suggestion.reason: Fixes an empty Favorites tab in the composer model picker.

topics.summary: The model picker opens on Favorites only when a saved favorite can actually be picked. Settings shows favorites that went missing from the catalog, so their stars can be removed.
topics.title: Model favorites stay usable after a provider is disabled

suggestion.reason: Clicking these links in f5's chat does nothing today. Most of the touched files exist in f5.

topics.summary: The Markdown sanitizer, ChatMarkdown's URL transform and the desktop shell allow local editor file URLs, so links like cursor://file/...:186 open the editor instead of doing nothing.
topics.title: cursor:// and vscode:// file links in chat open the editor

topics.reason: The diagnostic comes from ServerBrowserPage, upstream's headless-Chrome preview. f5 keeps its desktop-hosted preview, and policy says the server preview does not apply.

suggestion.reason: The diagnostic comes from ServerBrowserPage, upstream's headless-Chrome preview. f5 keeps its desktop-hosted preview, and policy says the server preview does not apply.

topics.summary: After a targeted click times out in the server headless browser, the error names the selector and says whether it now matches an element. The broker passes that reason through only for the server browser client.
topics.title: Server preview click timeouts identify the target

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix: an outside read transaction could stop all server writes indefinitely. f5 uses the same SQLite client.

topics.summary: If a reader's snapshot stops the checkpoint, the checkpoint worker now releases writer admission instead of blocking every write. An idle retry still reclaims the WAL after the reader closes.
topics.title: Server writes keep going while a reader pins the SQLite WAL

suggestion.reason: f5 keeps its desktop-hosted preview. By policy, upstream's server headless-Chrome preview topics don't apply.

topics.summary: ServerBrowser runs beforeunload when it closes headless preview pages, accepts unsaved-changes dialogs and waits for pagehide, with a 5 s force-close fallback.
topics.title: Server preview tabs run beforeunload when they close

suggestion.reason: Fixes a data-integrity bug in branch switching.

topics.summary: The branch picker's checkout runs without the 10 s timeout, so large repositories no longer end up half-switched, with HEAD on the old branch and target-branch files already written.
topics.title: Branch switch no longer kills a slow git checkout

suggestion.reason: This fixes a subagent status bug in the Claude adapter.

topics.summary: A completion for a task whose start is still buffered for the next wake is held behind that start, so the replay marks the child completed.
topics.title: Nested Claude subagents no longer stay running after they complete

suggestion.reason: Fixes thread navigation shortcuts in narrow windows.

topics.summary: Below 768px, the closed sidebar sheet keeps its contents mounted, so Cmd+1–9 and Cmd+Shift+[ or ] still switch threads. Hidden list measurements are discarded so rows don't animate when it reopens.
topics.title: Thread shortcuts work with the narrow sidebar closed

suggestion.reason: Dev tooling only. Users see no change.

topics.summary: dev-electron.mjs checks whether its parent PID changed and shuts down when it has, so orphaned supervisors stop relaunching Electron.
topics.title: Desktop dev supervisor stops when its parent process dies

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible rendering bug in chat Markdown.

topics.summary: The ordered-list gutter uses a probed marker width with a 3ch minimum, so wide or monospace interface fonts no longer cut off the first digit.
topics.title: Single-digit numbered lists no longer clip in wide fonts

suggestion.reason: Fixes ordering in the PR hub that f5 has.

topics.summary: Timeline events and list rankings compare parsed instants instead of ISO strings. UTC offsets and mixed fractional precision no longer put older activity first.
topics.title: PR lists and timelines sort by actual time, not timestamp text

suggestion.reason: Upstream's server headless-browser preview does not apply. f5 keeps its desktop-hosted preview.

topics.summary: Upstream ServerBrowser marks tabs visible, and picks the default tab, when a client streams them or the desktop shows them.
topics.title: Server browser reports desktop-shown tabs as visible

suggestion.reason: f5 has its own scheduler. The duplicate-queue symptom can occur for any recurring bound task, not only interval schedules, so judge it by behavior.

topics.summary: Before sending a timed occurrence of a thread-bound task, the scheduler skips it if a queued run for the same task is already waiting. Busy threads no longer collect a backlog of stale prompts.
topics.title: Recurring tasks keep at most one queued occurrence while their thread is busy

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stale-PATH symptom in f5's settings and forge discovery. os-jank and the shell helpers exist in f5.

topics.summary: Each Source Control discovery (page open and Rescan) re-reads PATH from the login shell and merges it into the server's own PATH before probing, so newly installed gh, glab or node resolve without a restart.
topics.title: Rescan finds tools installed after T3 Code started

suggestion.reason: Prevents losing typed text in a shared composer and question flow that f5 has.

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading effort display for the Claude provider.

suggestion.reason: A permission-safety fix for a provider f5 has.

topics.title: Restart-cancelled Codex background commands still wake their caller

topics.title: Cursor threads recover after repeated restarts instead of failing with 'already has active run'

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong timeline state after worktree handoffs. Reimplement in f5's orchestration layer.

suggestion.reason: Fixes a settings bug f5 can hit. Reimplement outside client-runtime.

suggestion.reason: Codex is an f5 provider, and this changes a misleading failure into a recoverable usage-limit state.
