topics.title: Codex ChatGPT Sharing limits offer usage-limit recovery

suggestion.reason: This fixes a visible settings bug in a theme importer f5 has.

topics.summary: Theme imports parse comments and trailing commas, so unmodified VS Code themes such as Solarized import.
topics.title: Theme import accepts VS Code JSONC files

topics.reason: This fixes the Working shelf, which f5 declined in favor of SidebarAttentionSection.

suggestion.reason: This fixes the Working shelf, which f5 declined in favor of SidebarAttentionSection.

topics.summary: When the Working, Snoozed or Settled shelf expands or collapses, list motion is reset so rows don't slide over the section headers.
topics.title: Sidebar shelf expansion no longer animates rows over headers

suggestion.reason: f5 has ACP and OpenCode providers, and every status refresh leaves junk sessions behind.

topics.summary: When the agent supports session deletion, the ACP registry health probe deletes its own session, with a best-effort 5 s limit. session/delete is allowed on ACP v1. OpenCode history no longer fills with empty sessions.
topics.title: ACP health probes delete their temporary sessions

suggestion.question: Should f5 drop sparkles icons, including the Auto runtime mode icon, and enforce that with a lint rule?
suggestion.reason: Small UX clarity change in surfaces f5 has: the runtime mode picker and the PR hub.

topics.summary: Replaces sparkles icons on web and mobile with specific ones (for example the Auto runtime mode and PR actions), and adds a lint rule that bans sparkles.
topics.title: Sparkles icons replaced with icons that say what controls do

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop bug where an agent's use of the preview breaks app downloads. f5 has the desktop preview CDP relay.

topics.summary: The CDP relay maps Browser.setDownloadBehavior to page-scoped behavior instead of dropping browserContextId, which applied it to the app session. Theme exports in Settings again open the save dialog instead of writing silently into Playwright's temp folder.
topics.title: Preview download settings no longer redirect app exports

suggestion.reason: Fixes underestimated costs for long-context requests in Usage.

topics.summary: Usage parses LiteLLM's context tiers and prices each request by its total input, including category costs, cache savings and speed premiums. Cached scans are repriced on read.
topics.title: Usage prices long-context requests at above-tier rates

suggestion.reason: Fixes a usage-limit banner symptom for Claude gateway users. Reimplement in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: When an API-key Claude session gets a direct 429 from a gateway such as CLIProxyAPI, the adapter reads '(reset after …)' from the error text. The usage-limit banner then shows the reset time instead of 'Reset time unavailable'.
topics.title: Claude keeps a gateway's reset time on a direct 429
perf(mobile): avoid code row scans while dragging file paths (#25484)

suggestion.reason: A UX improvement to file previews in f5's panels.

topics.summary: The built-in PDF viewer keeps a bounded cache of 50 document positions (page geometry, zoom, scroll), keyed by stable document identity and revision, so switching threads no longer resets the reading position.
topics.title: PDF previews keep their page and zoom across thread switches

suggestion.reason: This fixes the composer's model state for multi-instance providers, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Legacy driver-keyed draft selections apply only to the default instance, for every driver rather than only Antigravity. A second instance no longer shows a model missing from its own catalog and loses its reasoning control.
topics.title: Custom provider instances no longer inherit the default instance's draft model
fix(mobile): accept image drops in the iOS message input (#25532)

suggestion.reason: Fixes MCP pull request tool behavior in the PR hub, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The MCP unlink tool ignores stack-dismissed records, as the list, link and watch tools already do. Agents get wasLinked false, and no unlink command is sent that could make stack sync re-add the PR.
topics.title: unlink_pull_request reports a dismissed stack PR as not linked

suggestion.reason: This is a visible plan-status bug in ACP providers. Reimplement in f5's ACP layer.

topics.summary: Cancelled plan entries are kept as cancelled and dropped from todo steps. A plan with no outstanding steps completes.
topics.title: ACP cancelled plan steps no longer keep the plan running

topics.reason: This is mobile app code only.

suggestion.reason: This is mobile app code only.

topics.summary: Adds image drag and drop to the native Android composer.
topics.title: Android composer handles image drops

suggestion.reason: Restores Usage limits for a common way users save CLIProxy hub URLs.

topics.summary: A trailing management.html is dropped from the hub URL before v0/management is appended, so hubs saved as the web panel address list their accounts in Usage → Limits again.
topics.title: CLIProxy hub saved as its management.html URL shows accounts again

topics.reason: Client-runtime connection routing for paired remote environments, which f5 doesn't have.

suggestion.reason: Client-runtime connection routing for paired remote environments, which f5 doesn't have.

topics.summary: A route paired at a new address of the same kind is placed ahead of the saved one, so the client uses the new session's scopes.
topics.title: Re-pairing at a new address uses the new token

suggestion.reason: Small correctness fix in f5's shared symlink helper.

topics.summary: resolveSymlinkTarget probes the final target after following the 40th permitted link, matching Linux. Longer chains and cycles are still rejected.
topics.title: Atomic saves allow a chain of 40 symlinks

suggestion.reason: f5 has its own scheduler. Judged by behavior, readable refusal reasons for agents apply if f5 exposes a run-now MCP tool.

topics.summary: The MCP handler passes the ScheduledTaskError message on, such as the webhook-only refusal, instead of a generic 'could not be completed'.
topics.title: run_scheduled_task_now says why a run was refused

topics.reason: This lives in upstream's Tiptap rich-text composer, which f5 does not have.

suggestion.reason: This lives in upstream's Tiptap rich-text composer, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Bold, italic and strike input rules no longer match an opening delimiter that sits inside an earlier code span.
topics.title: Rich-text composer emphasis ignores delimiters inside inline code

suggestion.reason: Fixes a delegated-task race that stalls queued work. Reimplement in f5's orchestration.

topics.summary: The delegated_task.wake-policy command updates only the parent run's delegated-completion field inside the transaction. A stale snapshot can no longer put a completed run back to running and stall the queue.
topics.title: Changing a task's wake policy no longer reverts a checkpointed parent run

suggestion.reason: Fixes a delegation correctness bug. f5 has delegated tasks and queued wakes, so reimplement it in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: A parent's queued 'asked a question' wake is cancelled when the child's question is answered or closed, or the child finishes. A stale answer then no longer becomes the parent's reported result.
topics.title: A finished child's queued question wake is dropped

suggestion.reason: A small visual fix to the timeline's Markdown. f5 has the same file.

topics.summary: .chat-markdown strong goes from font-weight 600 to 700, so bold text stands out in chat messages.
topics.title: Bold text in rendered Markdown uses weight 700 again
docs(orchestration-v2): Codex rollback uses thread/revert on paginated threads (#25705)

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance fix. f5 must reimplement it in its own projection layer.

topics.summary: Adds a single-run getRun read for run-status checks, and the PR-sync sweep stops building full thread shells. On large databases this stops long holds on the SQLite reader that delayed thread switches.
topics.title: PR sync and run-status checks stop reading whole thread histories

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible bad-title bug in text generation, which f5 has. Reimplement it outside provider-core.

topics.summary: Thread title generation fails when the sanitized result is the literal placeholder 'title', so the seed title is kept instead of being overwritten.
topics.title: A model reply of "title" no longer becomes the thread title

suggestion.reason: This fixes the thread read state if f5 has the server visit watermark and its migration.

topics.summary: Startup migration seeds a local visit time only when the server watermark is null, so a deliberately older watermark set by Mark unread is kept.
topics.title: Local visit migration no longer undoes Mark unread

suggestion.reason: A small UX fix in Usage, a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: A new custom price row hides its 'required' error until a price or mapping is typed. Save stays disabled until then.
topics.title: Price dialog no longer flags a model before a price is entered

suggestion.reason: Makes PR hub actions faster and cuts forge calls. Reimplement inside f5's PR service; client-runtime does not exist in the fork.

topics.summary: Merge, close, reopen, draft, ready, auto-merge and update-branch return the new PR summary when the client opts in. Clients show the new state right away and skip the extra confirmation read. GitHub check paging no longer reads its first page twice.
topics.title: PR actions update clients from the host's reply instead of re-reading

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop temp-file leak on Linux that can fill a tmpfs quota.

topics.summary: Icon installs read and write the file instead of using copyFile from app.asar, which left a Chromium temp file behind on every launch.
topics.title: Linux launches no longer leave an icon copy in /tmp

suggestion.reason: This fixes the model picker for ACP registry agents, a provider surface f5 has.

topics.summary: When an ACP registry agent's session/load returns no models, the probed model list is kept and live option controls are applied to it, instead of collapsing to Default.
topics.title: Reopening a Kimi thread keeps its model list

suggestion.reason: Affects only the mobile app.

topics.summary: Adds native Select Text and Paste to the mobile iOS terminal, keeps newlines when pasting, and fixes a freeze.
topics.title: iOS terminal can copy and paste and no longer freezes

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop window-restore bug.

topics.summary: While maximized, the saved normal bounds are moved onto the window's current display. Moves of a maximized window are saved, so a restart maximizes on the right monitor.
topics.title: A maximized window reopens on the display it was last used on

suggestion.reason: Desktop bug fix for videos in chat messages.

topics.summary: The preload reports when the app document enters HTML fullscreen. The main process then sets OS fullscreen, while preview guests stay confined to the window.
topics.title: Chat videos go fullscreen across the whole screen again on desktop

topics.reason: Device and simulator tooling is a subsystem f5 does not have.

suggestion.reason: Device and simulator tooling is a subsystem f5 does not have.

topics.summary: The device_* MCP tools now resolve a host by its exact ID or by a single case-insensitive label match. An unknown host returns an error that lists the known hosts, instead of an empty result.
topics.title: Device tools accept a host's label and reject unknown hosts

suggestion.reason: Only the mobile app changes.

topics.summary: Patches keyboard-controller so keyboardDidShow without keyboardWillShow updates the visible state. The mobile terminal uses a show epoch.
topics.title: Mobile keyboard state follows Android's nonanimated IME show

suggestion.reason: Fixes unbounded disk growth from pinned runtimes, if f5 uses upstream's service runtimes.

topics.summary: The startup prune ignores a runtime's own entry binary that it finds through the service PATH. Old pinned runtimes, about 270 MB each, are no longer kept forever.
topics.title: Runtime prune no longer keeps every version whose directory is on the service PATH

suggestion.reason: f5 has storage cleanup (storageCleanup.enabled). Worktrees missing from the report is a bug its equivalent can show.

topics.summary: The storage report asks the project's git for linked worktrees nested inside non-git folders, such as <repo>/replay/<n>, and lists them. Before, they were left out.
topics.title: Storage report lists project worktrees nested inside plain folders

suggestion.reason: An accessibility improvement to the thread actions f5 has.

topics.summary: Undo announces what it restored and how many items, and pinning a thread is now announced through the live region.
topics.title: Screen readers hear when a thread is pinned or an action is undone

suggestion.reason: A Codex provider bug that leaves turns and delegated children stuck. It can occur in f5's Codex adapter.

topics.summary: The Codex adapter restores additionalContext after turn/completed instead of injecting it mid-turn. Mid-turn injections made the turn sample and compact again, so it never ended.
topics.title: Codex turns that auto-compact end instead of looping

suggestion.reason: The same symptom, a blank or unsynced thread pane after a subscription defect, can happen in f5's thread sync. Reimplement in f5's client state layer, since client-runtime doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: When a thread subscription ends on a defect, such as a socket snapshot that fails to decode, the client resubscribes with capped exponential backoff. The pane no longer stays at 'Could not synchronize the thread.' until the user switches threads.
topics.title: A thread whose live subscription dies on a defect resubscribes instead of staying blank

suggestion.reason: Better error UX for a provider f5 supports.

topics.summary: Known Cursor SDK login failures, such as API-key creation being restricted or a timeout, map to actionable messages, and the span records the failure.
topics.title: Cursor sign-in failures explain why they failed

suggestion.reason: f5's PR hub uses GitHub GraphQL reads, so the same false 'not found' can happen. Reimplement it in f5's GitHub layer.

topics.summary: The detail and action-state reads accept GitHub's single NOT_FOUND on baseRef.compare and keep the PR data, leaving the comparison unknown. The panel, merge and update-branch work, and watches don't give up.
topics.title: PRs missing refs/pull/N/head no longer show as not found

topics.reason: This only changes the upstream devices and simulators subsystem, which f5 does not have.

suggestion.reason: This only changes the upstream devices and simulators subsystem, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: The device service keeps known devices when a listing fails or times out, and reports incompletePlatforms so setup stops giving wrong runtime advice.
topics.title: Devices stay listed when simulator discovery fails
docs(readme): list fx as a supported provider (#25974)

suggestion.reason: Desktop preview reliability fix. If f5's preview host takes CDP screenshots of hidden guests, it can show the same symptom.

topics.summary: DesktopBrowserHost keeps a hidden guest painting until Chromium answers each sent capture, even after T3 stops waiting. Captures no longer stay pending offscreen and hold the 'Capturing' wake lock for hours.
topics.title: Hidden preview tab no longer keeps the display awake after a screenshot

suggestion.reason: Fixes upstream's compact-before-send / automatic resume compaction, which f5 declined.

topics.summary: The resume-compaction offer requires that no provider handoff is pending.
topics.title: Switching a cold Claude thread to Codex no longer compacts first

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken rendering of a common GitHub PR body layout in the PR hub. The mobile part does not apply.

topics.summary: The PR body splitter keeps an HTML table that holds media links as one segment and splits each cell on its own. Web renders the rows as equal-width columns, so side-by-side videos are no longer pulled out and stacked.
topics.title: PR bodies keep before/after video tables intact

suggestion.reason: A preview browser layout bug fix. It applies if f5 has the floating mini player.

topics.summary: When the layout has shrunk the floating mini browser below its minimum, resizing uses the starting frame as the minimum and keeps an explicitly saved width. An inward drag no longer stores a larger width.
topics.title: Inward resizes of a shrunken mini browser no longer grow it

suggestion.reason: A PR hub UX fix that prevents accidental merge confirmations.

topics.summary: Merge and Merge stack stay mounted, disabled with a tooltip reason, while the stack lookup is pending or failed, so the header controls don't shift into a misclick. Linked threads now render before the stack picker.
topics.title: PR merge buttons stay in place while the stack loads

suggestion.reason: Makes Claude turn failures easier to diagnose.

topics.summary: When the Claude CLI is killed by a signal or exits nonzero, the turn failure shows the SDK's message (for example 'terminated by signal SIGABRT') instead of a generic 'Provider turn failed'.
topics.title: A killed Claude process names its signal or exit code on the failed turn

suggestion.reason: Fixes RTL rendering in chat messages for Arabic users.

topics.summary: textDirection takes a majority by sentence instead of counting words across the whole block, so Arabic prose with long English terms or sentences gets dir=rtl.
topics.title: Arabic paragraphs with many English terms read right to left

suggestion.reason: Same local-environment-disabled readiness rule as the earlier group. It fixes a sidebar bug f5 can hit.

topics.summary: Project discovery no longer waits for a primary environment on desktops with the local environment disabled, so PR links held at launch resolve to their project.
topics.title: PR links at launch open the PR view with the local environment disabled

suggestion.reason: Small UX fix to a sidebar surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The ⌘1–⌘9 thread jump hints in the desktop sidebar use the shared Kbd component, so ⌘ is drawn full size. The hint now replaces the row's status slot instead of floating between the timestamp and the provider icon.
topics.title: Sidebar jump hints are readable and sit in the status slot

suggestion.reason: f5 has automatic branch rename and the Changes totals, so the same race can occur.

topics.summary: When a status refresh straddles the automatic branch rename, the review base falls back to HEAD instead of the remote's default branch. The Changes row no longer briefly shows hundreds of thousands of lines.
topics.title: Changes totals no longer use a guessed base after a branch rename

suggestion.reason: Stops reading every file under home, a serious performance and privacy problem.

topics.summary: Drops the overrides that let fff scan the home directory and filesystem root. A project rooted at home no longer reads nearly every file, which on Windows downloaded OneDrive online-only files.
topics.title: Workspace search no longer indexes the home directory or filesystem root
docs(mcp): t3_thread_update lists only its rename and title actions (#26130)

suggestion.reason: Linux desktop bug: the system setting was ignored.

topics.summary: The desktop reads the GNOME setting at startup. When it is false, middle-click PRIMARY paste is blocked in the app, preview guests and the terminal.
topics.title: Middle-click paste follows gtk-enable-primary-paste on Linux desktop

topics.reason: f5 declined the Working sidebar section and keeps SidebarAttentionSection.

suggestion.reason: f5 declined the Working sidebar section and keeps SidebarAttentionSection.

topics.summary: partitionSidebarThreads keeps threads whose environment is disconnected out of the collapsed Working shelf, so they no longer hide there.
topics.title: Threads on unreachable environments leave the Working shelf

suggestion.reason: A UX bug fix in the desktop preview browser annotation, which f5 has.

topics.summary: In the desktop preview's annotation mode, V, R, D and E are ignored only when focus is in an input, textarea or select inside the overlay. They no longer stop working after a toolbar button is clicked.
topics.title: Annotation tool keys work after clicking a toolbar button

suggestion.reason: Visual bug in panel title bar controls. The file differs in f5, but the symptom can occur if f5 animates the same controls.

topics.summary: The maximize button hides immediately when the right panel closes, instead of fading out next to the thread details toggle. It still fades in on open.
topics.title: Maximize button no longer jumps when the right panel closes

suggestion.reason: Desktop update reliability fix that applies to f5's desktop updater.

topics.summary: Patches electron-updater so its 60 s idle timeout arms under Electron's net request. Download failure toasts include the underlying cause, so a download behind a stalling proxy no longer sits at 0% forever.
topics.title: Stalled desktop update downloads time out and show why

suggestion.reason: This is a desktop startup reliability fix that can also happen with f5's managed backend.

topics.summary: The desktop backend readiness timeout goes from 1 to 3 minutes, so a backend with a large state database no longer triggers 'could not start' just before it becomes ready. Crash-loop recovery is unchanged.
topics.title: Desktop waits 3 minutes for a slow backend before showing recovery

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for active turns that stay stuck on Working after a restart. Reimplement against f5's effect worker equivalent, since orchestration-v2 doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: The effect outbox caps how many title generations run at once. After a restart, provider-turn starts no longer wait up to about 9 minutes behind requeued titles.
topics.title: Slow title generations no longer hold every effect worker

suggestion.question: Should f5 copied thread links use only the t3-thread:// scheme, or also an https link to a hosted app domain?
suggestion.reason: A user-visible thread UX improvement in the web sidebar, palette and chat. The hosted-URL form ties into upstream's hosted app.

topics.summary: Copy thread puts a thread link on the clipboard (t3-thread:// or app.t3.codes/threads/). Pasting it into the composer makes a thread chip, and opening it navigates to the thread.
topics.title: Copy thread copies a link that opens the thread
fix(mobile): smoother Settings and composer transitions on wide Android (#26297)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading error in provider updates, which f5 has.

topics.summary: When a provider update fails, the message now uses the last stderr/stdout line that names an error. Before, it used the last line, so a failed claude update showed only 'Try running claude doctor' instead of the real reason.
topics.title: Failed provider updates show the updater's error, not its closing hint

suggestion.reason: A small UX fix in the composer skill picker and skill chips.

topics.summary: formatProviderSkillDisplayName drops a plugin namespace that equals the skill name, so frontend-design:frontend-design shows as 'Frontend Design'.
topics.title: Claude plugin skills no longer show their name twice

suggestion.reason: Pi is an f5 provider, and rewind after a restart is a common path. Reimplement in f5's Pi adapter.

topics.summary: When rollback runs on a fresh Pi runtime, the adapter first registers the persisted thread, so it no longer fails with 'Pi session has no registered thread' after a restart or idle release.
topics.title: Rewinding a Pi conversation works after its session was released

suggestion.reason: A theme bug on desktop. It matters only if f5 supports running desktop with the local environment off against a same-machine service. Most touched web files are missing in the fork, so this would be a reimplementation.

topics.summary: With the desktop local environment off and the app connected to a background service that shares the T3 home, published themes and t3 theme set had no effect. Desktop now reads the host environment ID and takes themes from the matching connected environment when there is no primary environment.
topics.title: Published themes apply when desktop uses this machine's background service
fix(mobile): the Android split slides as one strip, so sidebar and detail pane always fill the widt…

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Windows Antigravity install failure in a subsystem f5 has.

topics.summary: Removes CHROME_CRASHPAD_PIPE_NAME from the browser-preflight helper's environment, so Crashpad stderr no longer breaks the preflight match and rolls back the install.
topics.title: Antigravity install no longer fails on a stale Windows Crashpad pipe

suggestion.reason: Fixes a chat markdown rendering bug in f5's ChatMarkdown.

topics.summary: The markdown pipeline records light and dark <picture> sources, and ChatMarkdown resolves the theme's source the way it resolves img src. Theme-aware README images then load in dark mode.
topics.title: Dark-mode <picture> images load instead of 'Image unavailable'

suggestion.reason: Fixes a keyboard bug for non-US desktop users.

topics.summary: The shortcut matcher no longer maps a dedicated + key to the US key at the same position. German and similar layouts zoom instead of triggering go forward.
topics.title: Ctrl/Cmd + '+' zooms on layouts with a dedicated plus key

suggestion.reason: Small visual improvement to the model picker, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The selection check sits right after the selected model's name, and the favorite star moves before the keyboard shortcut. The empty trailing gap after shortcuts is gone.
topics.title: Model picker rows drop the reserved check column

suggestion.reason: Fixes a thread that shows Input but has no card to answer or dismiss. Reimplement in f5's history paging, including the follow-up so the window keeps its floor.

topics.summary: Unanswered questions and approval cards stay in the loaded history and are recovered from saved client state. A follow-up keeps the history window from shrinking to one row after a Stop.
topics.title: Older pending questions stay answerable in long threads
fix(mobile): sending on iOS no longer leaves an autocorrected draft behind (#26452)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Claude subagent status bug. Reimplement it in f5's Claude adapter, since orchestration-v2 doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter ignores the placeholder tool result that a foreground fork's stream opens with for its own launch call. Subagent rows no longer say 'Completed in 1.0s' while the fork is still working.
topics.title: Foreground Claude forks no longer show as finished as soon as they start

topics.reason: Depends on running without a local environment against several saved services and on T3 Connect link state.

suggestion.reason: Depends on running without a local environment against several saved services and on T3 Connect link state.

topics.summary: With Local environment off, Sharing & access picks a connected background service and offers a picker. Pairing and T3 Connect actions use that service.
topics.title: Sharing & access shows a saved service when Local environment is off

topics.reason: The symptom only occurs under Hermes, the mobile JavaScript engine. Web and desktop already work.

suggestion.reason: The symptom only occurs under Hermes, the mobile JavaScript engine. Web and desktop already work.

topics.summary: threadLinkRefs uses RegExp exec instead of matchAll, because Hermes match objects have no groups property.
topics.title: Mobile thread links show their thread's title
test(web): linked-environment subagents keep opening in their own thread (#26492)

suggestion.question: Should f5's header New thread button open the project picker instead of starting in the current project when the project-grouped sidebar is on?
suggestion.reason: Sidebar UX fix that makes projects without active threads reachable. It applies if f5's sidebar has the same modes.

topics.summary: With the project-grouped sidebar, the header New thread button and the chat.new shortcut open the project picker when there are several projects, instead of starting in the current project. The legacy sidebar keeps creating local threads.
topics.title: Header New thread opens the project picker in the project-grouped sidebar

suggestion.reason: Only concerns outside-agent MCP clients, which fall under the relay-cloud skip area. The change is error text and docs.

topics.summary: The t3_thread_list target_required error mentions allProjects: true, and the outside-agents docs list the tools that need a thread credential.
topics.title: Outside MCP clients learn which tools need a thread and about allProjects

suggestion.reason: Fixes working ACP agents becoming unusable after a registry update. Reimplement in f5's ACP registry support.

topics.summary: The status check accepts an executable from any installed version, so agents like Devin aren't reported as unprepared and greyed out when the registry publishes a newer version.
topics.title: Installed ACP Registry binary agents stay ready after the registry advances

suggestion.reason: Agent behavior fix for the preview browser, if f5's preview toolkit has the same read-only wording.

topics.summary: preview_evaluate's description and the shared preview instructions now say page tools write only on user request, instead of read only. Adds eval cases.
topics.title: Agents may use page WebMCP write tools when the user asks
fix(mobile): un-settle while a settle is pending is no longer ignored (#26578)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong result in storage cleanup, which f5 has.

topics.summary: git status and ignored-file listings opt into bounded output with a truncation marker. Worktrees with large listings are then kept with 'Local changes exceed the inspection limit' instead of being reported as failed.
topics.title: Storage cleanup keeps worktrees whose file listing exceeds the inspection limit

suggestion.reason: f5 has storage cleanup, and the same error can fill its report. Keep f5's storageCleanup.enabled default.

topics.summary: An ENOTDIR from fs.exists is treated as missing, so threads whose stored worktree path sits under a file are skipped quietly instead of being reported as failed on every pass.
topics.title: Storage cleanup skips stale worktree paths that sit under a regular file

suggestion.reason: An important reliability fix for git and worktree operations.

topics.summary: Git commands get SIGKILL 1 s after SIGTERM when they time out, so a stuck process no longer holds one of the shared permits and blocks worktree creation for hours.
topics.title: Timed-out git commands that ignore SIGTERM no longer stall other git work

suggestion.reason: Stops agents from creating dead failed threads through MCP. Applies to f5's MCP toolkit.

topics.summary: The advertised-model check from delegate_task moves into a shared requireAdvertisedModel helper. t3_thread_launch now returns model_unavailable instead of creating a thread that fails seconds later.
topics.title: t3_thread_launch refuses models the provider doesn't advertise

suggestion.reason: Chat timeline UX fix, and ZoomableImage exists in f5.

topics.summary: In the expanded image viewer, only pinch and Ctrl+wheel zoom. A plain wheel or trackpad scroll pans through native overflow.
topics.title: Scrolling pans expanded images and Mermaid diagrams

suggestion.reason: Fixes Claude launch-argument settings that broke the first message in every project.

topics.summary: A leading ~ in these launch-argument file paths now expands to the home directory, instead of resolving against the project folder and failing the first message.
topics.title: Claude --settings and --append-system-prompt-file launch args expand ~

suggestion.reason: Provider reliability fix for ACP registry agents. Reimplement in f5's ACP adapter layer.

topics.summary: When GitHub Copilot CLI rejects session/prompt with a session-not-found or session-lock timeout error, the ACP adapter restarts the runtime. The next message then works instead of failing every time.
topics.title: Lost or locked Copilot ACP sessions restart on the next message

suggestion.reason: A performance improvement for MCP project listing.

topics.summary: t3_project_list slices rows before hydration instead of hydrating every project for each page. This cuts metadata and favicon work for paged listings.
topics.title: Project list pages hydrate only the requested projects
fix(mobile): keep Android thread title spacing consistent (#26666)

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance fix in effect-acp, which exists in f5.

topics.summary: The NDJSON framer scans only each incoming chunk for a newline instead of re-splitting the whole buffer. Large tool results from Cursor, Grok and other ACP agents are no longer framed in quadratic time.
topics.title: ACP stdout framer handles large lines in linear time

suggestion.reason: Accessibility fix in sidebar files f5 shares (sidebarTree.ts, SidebarThreadRow).

topics.summary: The sidebar goes back from an ARIA tree with one Tab stop to a list of buttons. It keeps the keyboard additions, so NVDA users can Tab to every thread and its buttons without entering focus mode.

topics.title: Terminal snapshots reuse WASM memory views

topics.title: Sidebar undo notice no longer pushes the update button out of view

topics.title: Cursor SDK write-after-end no longer crashes the server

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading update flow for provider CLIs installed through Nix.

topics.title: Provider CLIs installed through Nix no longer offer an update that can't run

suggestion.reason: Fixes blank new threads. This needs a reimplementation in f5's thread state, because client-runtime does not exist here.

topics.summary: A thread-detail 404 that arrives before the create command commits no longer stays cached as deleted. ChatView then resubscribes and renders the new thread.
topics.title: New thread content no longer stays blank after an early 404

suggestion.reason: Fixes threads that are stuck for good after a fork. f5 has thread forking.

topics.summary: When native forkThread fails because the source session no longer exists, the turn starts a fresh session instead of retrying forever, so the fork recovers.
topics.title: Forks whose source session is gone start fresh instead of failing every send

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken PR reads for credential-proxy users. This applies if f5 calls the GitHub API in-process rather than through gh. It must be reimplemented in f5's GitHub layer.

topics.summary: When gh config sets http_unix_socket, GitHub REST and GraphQL requests are sent through that socket, so credential-proxy users' PR reads work again. The request never falls back to a direct connection.
topics.title: GitHub API requests go through gh's configured http_unix_socket

suggestion.reason: Fixes confusing skill labels in the composer and message chips.

topics.summary: Skills without a displayName show their raw name instead of a title-cased split. Claude skills like superpowers:brainstorming then match what users type in the $ menu.
topics.title: Skill labels show the skill's own name

suggestion.reason: Makes silent data loss in session import visible to users.

topics.summary: Claude, Codex and Pi imports that pass the 200-message cap now start with a system notice saying how many messages were omitted.
topics.title: Imported threads disclose omitted history

topics.reason: Depends on the request_secret card, which f5 policy declines.

suggestion.reason: Depends on the request_secret card, which f5 policy declines.

topics.title: Agents ask for sudo passwords through the private secret card

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading report when an organization policy swaps the model, which can happen with f5's Claude task delegation. Reimplement outside orchestration-v2.

topics.title: Delegated Claude tasks report the model that actually ran

suggestion.question: Does f5 have settings secret references (#27746) to build per-host forge token references on?

topics.title: Source control host tokens can come from a secret provider

topics.title: OpenCode Go limits recover after a startup timeout

suggestion.reason: Clarifies provider setup UX for Antigravity, a provider f5 supports.

topics.summary: Antigravity instances that use a Gemini API key or Agent Platform show credential-specific status and a Connect button instead of Google sign-in wording. The configured type is kept after auth is cleared. The mobile part doesn't apply.

suggestion.reason: Improves usage settings, a surface f5 has. Pairs with the secret-provider host token work.

topics.summary: API keys for usage limit sources such as CLIProxyAPI accept a secret reference (for example 1Password) as well as a literal value. Older clients still see redacted strings.
topics.title: Usage limit source keys can come from a secret provider

suggestion.reason: Device hosts and simulators only.

topics.title: EAS device host token can come from a secret provider

topics.title: ACP session delete works for v1 agents that advertise it

suggestion.reason: This git and worktree bug can occur in f5. Worktree creation fails for repos with locale-sensitive hooks.

topics.summary: Git commands whose stderr T3 classifies now force LANGUAGE=C instead of LC_ALL=C. Hooks that need a UTF-8 locale, such as Ansible post-checkout hooks, no longer fail worktree creation and leave a stray worktree and branch behind.
topics.title: Git hooks keep the user's locale

topics.reason: F5 supports only OpenCode 1.x, explicitly rejects 2.x, and has no cached runtime-generation probe or 2.x adapter to fix.

topics.title: OpenCode sessions open after an in-place upgrade from 1.x to 2.x

suggestion.reason: Fixes a chat Markdown rendering bug in the timeline.

topics.summary: External links with code, bold or emphasis in their labels wrap instead of overflowing table cells and narrow lanes. A surrogate pair is no longer split.
topics.title: Formatted link labels wrap inside table cells

suggestion.reason: Fixes a composer folder-reference gate that wrongly refused servers running on this computer.

topics.summary: Folder drops and pastes are accepted on a saved direct loopback connection when the local environment is off. SSH, WSL, relay and non-loopback servers are still refused, and the error wording is clearer.
topics.title: Folder references work on saved local desktop servers

suggestion.reason: Fixes a lost reset time in Codex usage-limit recovery. f5 has Codex and its auto-resume flow.

topics.title: Codex first-request usage limits keep their reset time

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong links in chat markdown, which f5 renders.

topics.title: Bare URL links keep trailing underscores and tildes

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance and UX improvement in the PR hub.

topics.title: Pull requests show data the app already has instead of spinners

suggestion.reason: The same failure can happen in f5 with a local branch named t3code. Port the generic fix and keep f5's prefix.

topics.title: Generated branch rename works when a parent-named branch exists

suggestion.reason: Applies to f5's resume after restart, keeping f5's setting default. Prevents duplicate deploys and pushes.

topics.title: Closed PR watches end even when the activity read fails

topics.title: npm-installed Claude in ~/.local gets npm updates, not claude update

suggestion.reason: Fixes a provider update warning bug that can occur in f5's Claude driver.

topics.summary: Native installs check the native latest or stable feed, honoring user and managed channel settings, instead of npm. This ends a stuck update warning after 'claude update' says it is current.
topics.title: Native Claude installs compare against the native release feed
fix(mobile): review diff no longer goes blank after switching sections (#27960)

suggestion.reason: Relay and tunnel infrastructure only.

topics.title: T3 Connect repairs tunnel ingress that drifted from a matching origin

suggestion.reason: A measurable cut in process spawns for projects whose folders are gone.

topics.title: Missing or non-folder project paths skip git probes

suggestion.reason: f5 has its own scheduler and MCP task tools. Check whether its MCP path hardcodes main, and port if it does.

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stuck title state on subagent threads. Reimplement outside provider-core.

topics.title: Subagent threads no longer inherit a pending title job

suggestion.reason: Fixes a race in provider status updates.

topics.summary: upsertProviders publishes the latest committed providers instead of a possibly stale array. Clients now see the final update state without a reload.
topics.title: Open clients no longer stay on 'Updating' after a provider update

suggestion.reason: Long paths are cut off in f5's file chip tooltips. Apply the fix to f5's equivalent file-link component.

topics.title: File chip tooltips show the whole path

topics.reason: F5 uses provider-reported costs without LiteLLM pricing.

suggestion.reason: Makes search results match regular sidebar rows. Sidebar.tsx and SidebarThreadRow exist in f5.

suggestion.reason: Improves agent use of f5's preview browser MCP tools and avoids blank tabs.

suggestion.reason: Fixes Codex runs that stay running forever, a reliability bug in a provider f5 has.

suggestion.reason: A new composer capability for supported providers. It ships off by default, which matches policy.

topics.title: A git action that fails partway refreshes the Git panel

suggestion.reason: Large memory and reliability improvement to MCP task cancellation, which f5 has.

topics.summary: cancelTask no longer decodes every subagent, with full prompts, or the parent and child history. Upstream saw a median of +1 GB per heap spike.
topics.title: Cancelling a task reads only the tasks and runs it uses

suggestion.reason: Text generation failures from a split emoji can happen in f5. Reimplement in f5's text generation utils.

topics.summary: limitSection and limitTitleMessage step back one code unit at a high surrogate. A lone surrogate no longer makes provider JSON parsers reject commit, PR or title generation requests.
topics.title: Text generation context cuts no longer split an emoji

topics.reason: Upstream's server headless-Chrome preview stream does not apply. f5 keeps its desktop-hosted html_preview.

suggestion.reason: Upstream's server headless-Chrome preview stream does not apply. f5 keeps its desktop-hosted html_preview.

topics.title: Server preview stream withdraws a stale file picker when it drops

suggestion.reason: Small fix to how thread titles are generated, which f5 users see.

topics.title: Thread titles use linked PR context when the URL is followed by a colon or bold markers
test(web): worked-for expand test waits for the timeline to finish loading (#29661)

suggestion.reason: Git status bug fix that applies to f5.

topics.summary: The stale-upstream refresh reads %(upstream:remotename), skips branches whose upstream is local ('.'), and fetches only real remotes.
topics.title: Status no longer fetches a remote named after a local tracked branch

suggestion.reason: Fixes a reliability and resource leak on Linux desktop updates.

topics.summary: The AppImage relaunch runs through bash, which closes inherited file descriptors before exec. Old runtimes and FUSE mounts then exit after each update.
topics.title: AppImage updates no longer leave old runtimes and mounts running

suggestion.reason: Cuts logging I/O and log size for OpenCode sessions.

topics.summary: The native event logger ignores message.part.delta events. Each part's final message.part.updated is still logged.
topics.title: OpenCode provider event logs skip per-token reply deltas
docs: keybindings guide lists the rightPanelOpen when key (#29677)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a keybinding bug in f5's sidebar and preview surfaces. When reimplementing, map previewOpen to f5's desktop-hosted preview panel.

topics.summary: The sidebar's keydown listener now passes previewFocus and previewOpen to resolveShortcutCommand. Custom thread.next, thread.previous and thread.jump rules with when-clauses on those conditions now work.
topics.title: Thread navigation shortcuts honor previewFocus and previewOpen conditions

topics.reason: Concerns the device pairing setup flow for T3 Connect and LAN, which the policy files under relay-cloud.

suggestion.reason: Concerns the device pairing setup flow for T3 Connect and LAN, which the policy files under relay-cloud.

topics.summary: The 'Run t3 pair' next step from t3 up includes the --base-dir flag the user passed.
topics.title: t3 up's pairing hint keeps --base-dir

suggestion.reason: Fixes dev-server attribution for Codex threads in f5's preview and port discovery.

topics.summary: The Codex app-server process is tracked by port discovery, so listeners started from its shells are attributed to the thread.
topics.title: Dev servers a Codex agent starts show under its thread

suggestion.reason: Fixes a git publish bug: without it the user can try to create the same repository twice.

topics.summary: The publish handler refreshes repository identity and git status even when the first push fails. The Git menu then stops offering Publish for a repository that already exists.
topics.title: A publish whose first push fails still shows the new remote

suggestion.reason: Review diff bug that can occur in f5's git layer.

topics.summary: ls-files lists a nested repository with a trailing slash. The per-file untracked filter now accepts that form, so review rows for nested repos load.
topics.title: Review rows for nested repositories load in large diffs

suggestion.reason: Fixes terminals staying mis-sized after a reconnect. client-runtime does not exist in f5, so reimplement in f5's terminal state.

topics.summary: A later attach snapshot, such as after a socket reconnect, starts a new output generation. Viewers then replay their measured grid size, so the terminal resizes to its pane again.
topics.title: Terminals fit their pane again after a reconnect

suggestion.reason: Small layout fix in the sidebar and new-thread picker, both of which f5 has.

topics.summary: In the sidebar project menu and the new-thread picker, the hover-only pin moves left of the remote badge. The badge and gear stay together, with no gap on rows that aren't hovered.
topics.title: Project pin sits before the remote badge in project menus
fix(mobile): drafts on threads with colons in their ids upload attachments early (#29717)

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance improvement in git and PR status polling.

topics.summary: A confirmed closed or merged PR for a branch is cached with a branch-ref fingerprint and rechecked every 15 minutes. The settlement sweep no longer spawns about 6 git processes per thread every minute.
topics.title: Settled PR lookups stop spawning git every sweep

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix in a shared MCP response parser.

topics.summary: The SSE parser splits events and lines on CRLF, lone CR or LF, so MCP servers that use CR line endings no longer stall or drop responses.
topics.title: MCP response streams accept CR and mixed line endings

suggestion.reason: Fixes command output rendering that f5 shares in terminalOutput.

topics.summary: The command output emulator ignores CSI sequences with private or colon parameters (except SGR), and erase modes other than 2 no longer clear whole lines or the screen. Output is no longer lost or mangled.
topics.title: Command output ignores unsupported control parameters and erase modes
fix(mobile): Android alerts and the live card show the same status bar icon (#29738)

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale chat images on web and desktop, a timeline surface f5 has. Port only the web part, inside f5's asset layer.

topics.summary: Chat timeline images get the thread's workspace mutation id through a context and fetch a fresh signed URL after the agent touches the workspace. A regenerated image at the same path no longer shows the old cached picture.
topics.title: Chat images reload when the agent rewrites the file

suggestion.reason: Clearer error for a Cursor provider failure. Reimplement inside f5's Cursor provider.

topics.summary: When Cursor text generation hits a usage limit, the error says so and suggests another text-generation provider. The SDK error is kept as the cause.
topics.title: Cursor text generation names usage-limit failures

topics.reason: F5 has no selection-to-Markdown serializer; code-copy writes source text directly.

suggestion.reason: Fixes corrupted code when copying from the chat timeline, which f5 has.

topics.summary: When a selection is turned back into Markdown on copy, blank-line collapsing skips fenced code. Code inside list items, blockquotes or fences with nested ``` now keeps its blank lines and trailing spaces.
topics.title: Copied code blocks keep blank lines in lists, quotes and longer fences

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance gain in f5's Claude skill discovery.

topics.summary: Plugin skill discovery caches each repository root per project path and drops tracing spans from root lookups. Install records repeat paths hundreds of times.
topics.title: Claude skill discovery resolves each repository root once

suggestion.reason: Observability and performance fix. Apply it to f5's live event coalescer if one exists. The upstream file is in orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: Removes tracing from cancelWindow, flushPending and offerAll in ThreadLiveEventCoalescer. Their sub-millisecond spans flooded the rotating trace.
topics.title: Stop tracing per-event live coalescer work

suggestion.reason: Small search UX fix in shared code that f5 has.

topics.summary: Thread search folds curly single quotes to straight apostrophes, so a straight apostrophe finds text typed with ’ and the reverse.
topics.title: Find in thread matches a word typed with a curly apostrophe

suggestion.reason: The behavior change is mobile-only. The web side is only moving a helper.

topics.summary: Mobile thread settings and the outbox apply an implicit fastMode selection. The web helper moves into shared, with no change on web.
topics.title: Mobile: Fast can be turned on for an existing thread

suggestion.reason: Fixes timeline status for OpenCode, a provider f5 supports.

topics.summary: In the OpenCode 1.x adapter, tool parts that Stop aborted map to interrupted instead of failed. Stopped edits no longer show 'Tool execution aborted' as their diff.
topics.title: OpenCode tools stopped mid-run show as interrupted, not failed

suggestion.reason: Small forge fix. Reimplement in f5's Azure DevOps layer.

topics.summary: The Azure DevOps change request regex accepts visualstudio.com/DefaultCollection/ URLs.
topics.title: Legacy DefaultCollection Azure DevOps PR URLs can be pasted to check out

suggestion.reason: Fixes custom commands in the OpenCode provider.

topics.summary: OpenCode slash-command parsing accepts names containing slashes, so nested custom commands run as commands instead of being sent as plain prompt text.
topics.title: OpenCode nested custom commands like /git/commit run as commands

suggestion.reason: The bug can occur in f5's PR watch subsystem. Reimplement it in f5's PR watch evaluator.

topics.summary: A missing head SHA, which Azure DevOps omits when its iteration read fails, keeps the last known head instead of reading as a push. Later pushes and conflict changes wake the watch again.
topics.title: PR watches wake again when a push leaves the branch conflicting

suggestion.reason: Clearer error text for f5's Pi provider.

topics.summary: Pi extension error labels use the folder name when the extension loads from an index file.
topics.title: Pi extension errors name folder extensions instead of "index"

suggestion.reason: Observability fix in f5's provider event logger.

topics.summary: Provider event NDJSON log file names add a hash when the safe thread segment is truncated, so long delegated thread ids no longer collide in one file.
topics.title: Delegated threads no longer share one provider event log

suggestion.reason: Fixes how renamed files show in PR hub diffs. Reimplement in f5's forge adapters.

topics.summary: Synthesized PR patches add a similarity index header before the rename from and rename to lines, so the diff renderer shows renames instead of a deletion plus an addition.
topics.title: Renamed files in GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps PR diffs show as renames
fix(mobile): shorten the iOS undo toast and balance its insets (#29775)

topics.reason: Peer environment links are a multi-environment feature.

suggestion.reason: Peer environment links are a multi-environment feature.

topics.summary: Peer link status checks update the stored label from the name the peer's address answers with.
topics.title: Linked environments pick up the other machine's new name

suggestion.reason: This bug can happen in f5's worktree launch flow. It complements the ready topic pr-28373, which cleans up after a failed worktree add. Port it into f5's launch rollback, keeping the t3code/ prefix.

topics.summary: When a new-worktree launch is cancelled or fails before the thread records its workspace, rollback now deletes the branch it created, including a name from a rename that already finished, as well as the worktree. Leftover branches no longer clutter pickers or push later launches to a -1 suffix.
topics.title: Cancelling worktree setup no longer leaves its new branch behind

suggestion.reason: Observability reliability fix in a shared file that exists in f5.

topics.summary: Persisted observability settings are decoded from only the observability field. A value elsewhere in the settings file that the server migrates on load no longer makes the OTLP export config get dropped.
topics.title: OTLP export settings survive a saved token streaming mode

suggestion.reason: A wrong model selection in the composer is a user-visible bug in f5's draft store.

topics.summary: Model picks scoped to a provider instance are no longer rewritten by static alias normalization. A custom slug that matches a Codex alias stays the model the user picked.
topics.title: Picking a custom model named like a Codex alias keeps that model

topics.reason: Guest thread sharing is part of upstream's hosted sharing surface, which f5 doesn't have.

suggestion.reason: Guest thread sharing is part of upstream's hosted sharing surface, which f5 doesn't have.

topics.summary: GuestShareService.attachment also searches the fork's timeline, so guests can load images and files on messages the fork inherited from its source.
topics.title: Guests of a shared forked thread can open inherited attachments

suggestion.reason: Checkpoint revert bug that f5 can hit, and it bloats later checkpoints.

topics.summary: Checkpoint restore runs git clean again, up to 4 passes, after removing new .gitignore files. Files they hid, such as node_modules and .env, no longer stay behind and get caught in later checkpoints.
topics.title: Reverting files removes what a new .gitignore from the turn was hiding

suggestion.reason: Agents get more accurate text from document attachments.

topics.summary: Office text extraction for agents skips tracked deletions, moves, field codes and paragraph properties. It also drops markup-compatibility fallbacks when a Choice already has text, so Word text boxes are not extracted twice.
topics.title: Document attachment text skips hidden parts and no longer repeats Word text boxes

suggestion.reason: A user-visible capability for the Claude provider. f5 already has the shared MCP App code; reimplement this in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter detects MCP tools that declare a ui:// resource, saves the app HTML as an MCP App attachment and implements listTools, callTool and readResource. Claude threads now show the app instead of the plain result. Bumps the Claude Agent SDK to 0.3.316.
topics.title: MCP Apps render from Claude tool calls

suggestion.reason: Composer send failure with terminal context can happen in f5.

topics.summary: Terminal context text is clamped to the contract's max length and never ends on a lone high surrogate, so large terminal selections no longer make sends fail.
topics.title: Big terminal selections no longer break sending

suggestion.question: Should f5 permanently prune orchestration events once its projections cover them, giving up rebuilding projections from the event log?
suggestion.reason: A large storage and performance win, but it permanently drops event history and is built on orchestration-v2. It would ship off by default in f5's own persistence layer.

topics.summary: Background maintenance deletes orchestration events that the projections have already applied, not only superseded ones, and removes projection verification from history. Upstream saw a 6+ GB event table.
topics.title: Prune event log rows that projections already cover

suggestion.reason: Fixes a project setting being ignored when worktrees are created. This applies if f5 has per-project worktree settings.

topics.summary: When the MCP worktree handoff does not pass startFromOrigin, it now uses the project-resolved newWorktreesStartFromOrigin setting instead of the global server setting.
topics.title: Worktree handoff follows the project's start-from-origin setting
fix(web): file save session browser test no longer hangs on the discovery poll (#29813)

suggestion.reason: Sidebar unread-state bug that f5 users can hit. Reimplement outside client-runtime.

topics.summary: The thread visit tracker records an already-seen update as dispatched, so a later mark-unread is not undone when the thread is reopened.
topics.title: Mark unread sticks on a thread reopened within ten minutes

topics.reason: Mobile app links and hosted well-known files only.

suggestion.reason: Mobile app links and hosted well-known files only.

topics.title: Copied thread links open the mobile app

suggestion.reason: A forge bug fix in the PR hub: the branch shows no PR, and the app offers to create one that already exists.

topics.title: Azure DevOps: a fork's same-named branch no longer hides the branch's own PR

suggestion.reason: f5 has the OpenCode provider and generated titles.

topics.summary: OpenCode 2 text generation attaches only native image attachments whose files the server can open, so title generation no longer fails on missing images.
topics.title: OpenCode 2 titles for image messages skip unreadable images

suggestion.reason: f5 ships the Antigravity provider. Clearer text generation errors are a user-visible fix.

topics.summary: Antigravity commit, PR and title generation now shows sign-in-required and provider setup errors instead of a generic failure.
topics.title: Antigravity text generation shows sign-in and setup errors

suggestion.reason: Fixes the command status the OpenCode provider shows in the timeline.

topics.summary: An OpenCode shell tool part that completes with a non-zero exit code is marked failed instead of completed, so the timeline shows the command failed.
topics.title: OpenCode commands that exit non-zero are stored as failed

topics.reason: Only the mobile secret-request card changes, and f5 declined the secret-request card.

suggestion.reason: Only the mobile secret-request card changes, and f5 declined the secret-request card.

topics.summary: A native Android secret input turns off credential autofill for the mobile request_secret card.
topics.title: Android secret requests no longer offer password manager logins

topics.summary: The checkpoint git add runs with -c core.safecrlf=false. LF files under CRLF conversion are captured instead of making the checkpoint fail.
topics.title: Turn checkpoints keep LF files when core.safecrlf is true

topics.reason: F5 uses version 1 drafts without upstream’s v3–v5 selection maps.

suggestion.reason: Composer draft data loss after an upgrade can happen in f5's composerDraftStore.

topics.summary: Persisted composer drafts from storage v3–v5 used a provider field and object-shaped options. Their model selections are now decoded through the ModelSelection schema, so old drafts load instead of being discarded.
topics.title: Drafts saved by older versions load instead of being wiped

suggestion.reason: Fixes orphaned draft and upload leaks in f5's side chats. Reimplement without client-runtime.

topics.summary: After a thread is deleted, its side chats' composer drafts are cleared and their staged uploads are released. Deleting a side chat directly does the same.
topics.title: Deleting a thread clears its side chats' drafts and uploads

suggestion.reason: f5 has usage-limit auto-resume, and this fixes attribution and child follow-up delivery.

topics.summary: Automatic usage-limit continuations show as sent by T3 Code. Resumed child threads still create a tracked follow-up and deliver their result to the parent.
topics.title: Usage-limit auto-resume is attributed to T3 Code
test(scripts): expect the unmatched-pattern flag in the Astro check:changed test (#29839)

suggestion.reason: Agents stop picking providers that delegate_task will reject. Applies if f5 has per-project provider enablement.

topics.summary: The capabilities tool marks provider instances disabled when the caller's project disables them, matching what delegate_task enforces.
topics.title: orchestrator_capabilities no longer offers providers the project turned off

suggestion.reason: Fixes project creation failing for users with strict CRLF git config.

topics.summary: Managed project creation runs git add with -c core.safecrlf=false, so the scaffolded README and icon are added even with core.safecrlf=true and CRLF conversion on.
topics.title: New projects are created when core.safecrlf refuses LF files

topics.title: An environment link card the user moved past no longer blocks auto-settle

topics.title: Editing a scheduled task shows its saved time when the hour has one digit

suggestion.reason: A user git config hides changes in f5's turn and review diffs.

topics.summary: Turn and review diffs pass --submodule=short. Users with diff.submodule=log no longer lose submodule changes, which client patch parsers dropped.
topics.title: Diffs keep submodule changes under diff.submodule=log

topics.title: Deleting a thread also removes its agent preview recordings

suggestion.reason: This is the server headless-Chrome preview, which f5 policy says does not apply.

topics.title: A preview_open whose first load fails no longer leaves a hidden server-browser tab

suggestion.reason: Prevents a CLI command from removing the wrong background service. f5 ships the same service CLI.

topics.summary: If the installed boot service serves a different base dir, uninstall leaves it in place and tells the user to pass that --base-dir.
topics.title: t3 service uninstall leaves another T3 home's service alone

suggestion.reason: Clearer errors for OpenCode text generation in f5.

topics.summary: OpenCode 1.x commit, PR, branch and title generation errors are built from the typed error name and HTTP status, not from raw provider text such as '<none>'. Users can tell rate limits, outages and rejected credentials apart.
topics.title: OpenCode text generation errors describe known provider failures
fix(mobile): multi-file patches show every changed file (#29878)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a git bug that can occur in f5's commit and PR generation.

topics.summary: The staged name-status, the staged patch and the range stat and patch run with -c diff.relative=false. In subfolder projects, Commit no longer reports 'no changes', and generated text covers files outside the folder.
topics.title: Commit and PR text see changes outside a subfolder project under diff.relative

suggestion.reason: Fixes review failing entirely in sparse-checkout repos.

topics.summary: The temporary-index git add in review runs with core.sparseCheckout=false. Untracked files outside the sparse-checkout cone no longer make the whole review fail.
topics.title: Review diffs keep working with untracked files outside the sparse cone

suggestion.reason: Policy says upstream's server headless-Chrome preview does not apply to f5, which keeps its desktop-hosted html_preview.

topics.summary: ServerBrowser.createTab closes the pages and targets it opened when tab setup throws.
topics.title: Server preview tabs that fail during setup no longer leave their page open

suggestion.reason: f5 has its own scheduler in apps/server/src/scheduledTasks. This fixes the run error display there.

topics.summary: ScheduledTaskService errorMessage squashes a Cause to its error message instead of using Cause.pretty, so failed runs show a readable reason.
topics.title: A failed scheduled run shows its error without a stack trace

topics.reason: F5 represents subagents as parent-thread activities and has no sidebar-hidden subagent or side-chat threads that project opening could select.

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong navigation in the command palette.

topics.summary: When the command palette or re-adding a folder opens a project's latest thread, it ignores sidebar-hidden subagent and side-chat threads, so it lands on the main conversation.
topics.title: Opening a project from the command palette skips subagents and side chats

suggestion.reason: Fixes a user-visible PR checkout gap for GHE users. Port it into f5's GitHub forge link parsing.

topics.summary: PR link input now accepts any http(s) host in the owner/repo/pull/N form, not only github.com. Pasting a GitHub Enterprise Server PR URL now starts a checkout.
topics.title: GitHub Enterprise Server PR URLs can be pasted to check out

suggestion.reason: f5 keeps a desktop-hosted preview browser. If its guest input handler uses the same meta-or-control check, the same symptom occurs there.

topics.title: Ctrl+R on macOS reaches the preview page instead of reloading it

suggestion.reason: Fixes a provider status race in f5's ProviderRegistry.

topics.summary: Provider refresh checks that the instance is still current before it publishes. A refresh that started before a settings change no longer overwrites the new instance's status.
topics.title: Provider settings changed mid-refresh no longer revert to the old status

suggestion.reason: Small fix to a misleading CLI message.

topics.summary: When a restart is pending, the message says the service runs the version before the new one, instead of naming the new version.
topics.title: t3 update no longer says a service awaiting restart runs the new version

suggestion.reason: f5 supports rollback and native forks for Claude and OpenCode, so the agent can get history the fork doesn't show. The fix has to be reimplemented inside f5's fork path.

topics.title: Native forks after an undo no longer copy later turns

suggestion.reason: This is a reliability fix for idle compaction, if f5 has that feature. It does not touch the declined compact-before-send behavior.

topics.title: Idle compaction still runs after a queued message is removed or steered

suggestion.reason: Fixes incomplete context when switching providers or opening a side chat. Reimplement in f5's handoff layer.

topics.summary: Provider-switch history and side-chat or fork delta summaries list every path of a multi-file change, not just the first. The receiving agent learns about every edited file.

suggestion.reason: A user-visible emoji truncation fix in subagent thread titles, like the other surrogate-safe truncation fixes.

topics.title: PR review guides no longer fail on the repository's checkout hooks

suggestion.reason: Fixes a git and worktree bug in monorepo subfolder projects. The files exist in f5.

topics.title: Picking a branch in a subfolder project keeps the thread in the project folder

suggestion.reason: This fixes a delegation bug: child questions sat unanswered behind long parent turns.

topics.title: Subagent questions reach a busy parent agent

suggestion.reason: f5 has the Muse provider. This is a user-visible fix that also hides secrets.

topics.summary: The session lastError shown in the thread banner goes through makeProviderFailure, so it gets the same bounded, redacted text as the failure item.
topics.title: Muse thread error banner no longer shows unredacted failure text

suggestion.reason: Affects only device hosts, which f5 doesn't have.

topics.summary: The Settings → Device hosts connection test shows the server's error message instead of Cause.pretty output.
topics.title: Device host checks show the error without a stack trace

topics.summary: When a linked environment returns a JSON-RPC error or refuses a tool call, PeerMcpClient returns that failure as the call's result. It no longer fails the transport, which had marked the whole peer link as failing.
topics.title: A peer refusing one call no longer marks its link as failing
docs: pin an absolute binary path under a permission cap (#29916)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading count in Settings › Projects. Reimplement outside client-runtime.

topics.summary: The 'delete its N threads?' count when removing a project or checkout leaves out side chats and subagent threads. Those never appear in thread lists, and they made the number shift.
topics.title: Project removal confirm counts only listed threads
