topics.summary: Resumed Claude sessions set MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0 unless the instance sets it, so the first request waits for MCP servers. Claude no longer tells the agent that every MCP server disconnected.
topics.title: Resumed Claude sessions wait for their MCP servers

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading fork timeline: it shows turns the forked agent never received. Reimplement in f5's projection layer.

topics.summary: Fork timelines skip source runs that were rolled back before the fork was created. Runs rolled back after the fork stay visible in it.
topics.title: A fork made after Edit from here no longer shows the rewound turns

suggestion.reason: Fixes ACP agents hanging on commands that start background servers.

topics.summary: The ACP client terminal publishes the exit status after a 1 s output-drain grace, so a detached child that inherits the pipes no longer makes terminal/wait_for_exit hang.
topics.title: ACP wait_for_exit answers when a background child holds the output pipes

suggestion.reason: Stops f5 delegation from cluttering users' ChatGPT and Codex Recents.

topics.summary: When a delegated Codex child's task is completed and its result delivered, the idle unload archives the child with thread/archive. It is unarchived on its next turn.
topics.title: Finished delegated Codex children no longer pile up in Codex Recents

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken chat file links for agents working in nested gitignored worktrees.

topics.summary: When an index search finds no match for a slashed path, workspace search also checks live git worktrees nested in the project. Links to files inside gitignored worktrees such as .worktrees/x then resolve.
topics.title: File links relative to a gitignored git worktree open the file

suggestion.reason: Fixes delegated children left stuck after a server restart. Reimplement in f5's recovery queries.

topics.summary: Runtime recovery follows only provider-native subagent provider threads. A delegated child's background roster is then reconciled on its own thread, and the child gets its restart note and continuation.
topics.title: Restart recovery wakes delegated children waiting on background work

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading Stop in the OpenCode provider, matching how Claude and ACP handle it.

topics.summary: When session.interrupt gets no reply within 10 s, the turn stays open with an interrupt-timeout error, so Force stop is offered instead of showing 'Stopped' while tools keep running.
topics.title: A Stop OpenCode 2 never answers offers Force stop

suggestion.reason: Visible Cursor provider improvement. Needs the SDK patch.

topics.summary: A patch to @cursor/sdk publishes agent shell stdout and stderr through a hook, and the adapter maps it to live command output. Before, output appeared only at the end.
topics.title: Cursor agent shell commands stream their output while they run

suggestion.reason: Both changes are inside upstream's ContextHandoffService and handoff budget, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Side chats forked from a busy parent no longer show a 'Context handoff X → X' row and recover history from the parent. Handoff context lists the omitted item IDs instead of a read from the thread's start.
topics.title: Context handoff: side chat fork row and omitted-item recovery hints

suggestion.reason: Fixes overlapping, unreadable text in the composer area, if f5 has the same context strip.

topics.summary: ComposerSurface.ContextStrip gets the surface-glass utility, so timeline text no longer shows through the environment, worktree and branch labels.
topics.title: Context row under the composer hides chat text scrolling behind it

suggestion.reason: Makes the model shown for Claude subagents accurate. Must be reimplemented in f5's Claude adapter, since upstream's orchestration-v2 does not exist here.

topics.summary: For `context: fork` skills, the Claude adapter reads the model from the fork subagent's transcript, because the CLI never streams the fork's assistant frames. The subagent then records the model it actually ran on.
topics.title: Claude forked skills record the model they run on

suggestion.reason: Checkpoints are an f5 surface. A slow git add -A delaying every prompt is a reliability problem that can happen in f5's checkpoint layer.

topics.summary: captureBaseline puts a 5 s limit on the snapshot only, and only after it holds the per-cwd lock and has checked for an existing ref. In a slow workspace the provider turn starts without a baseline instead of waiting. Waits on the lock behave as before.
topics.title: A slow baseline checkpoint no longer holds every prompt for 30 seconds

suggestion.reason: Fixes context being lost in question answers. pendingUserInput.ts exists in f5.

topics.summary: projectPendingUserInputAnswer now expands review-comment chips into the same marker plus t3_context entry that normal messages use. Before, these chips reached the agent as bare t3-context links.
topics.title: Review comments in question answers reach the agent with their text

suggestion.reason: Fixes repository identity in shared git parsing, which f5 has.

topics.summary: parseGitRemoteRepository strips .git once from the URL pathname, so remotes ending in .git?x or .git#y resolve to owner/repo and .git.git is handled the same way as the SCP form.
topics.title: A query or fragment after .git keeps the repository identity

suggestion.reason: Settings that freeze during a provider update can happen in f5. Reimplement in f5's client state layer, since client-runtime doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: The updateProvider RPC leaves the per-environment config lane, so provider toggles, settings writes and keybinding writes no longer queue behind a long install. The server already rejects a second update of the same provider.
topics.title: Settings writes no longer wait for a running provider update

suggestion.reason: Privacy fix in the preview browser. Port only if f5 has Incognito profiles.

topics.summary: Preview navigations and page titles from Incognito-profile tabs are no longer saved to the project's browser history.
topics.title: Incognito browser visits stay out of project history

suggestion.reason: Makes Codex subagent rows in the timeline more useful. Codex is an f5 provider.

topics.summary: The Codex adapter fills in subagent progress from the child's command, MCP and dynamic tool item starts, as the Claude adapter already does. A reopened child drops its old progress line.
topics.title: Codex subagent rows show the child's current command

suggestion.reason: Build and release validation only, with no runtime behavior change.

topics.summary: build-desktop-artifact checks that the packaged server in each linux*-unpacked app.asar is self-contained, and fails when the unpacked app is missing.
topics.title: Linux desktop builds run the packaged-server self-check

suggestion.reason: T3 Connect reachability diagnostics only.

topics.summary: The T3 Connect reachability check looks up names that fail with not-found codes through public DNS over HTTPS. Other lookup failures keep the DNS/VPN message.
topics.title: T3 Connect says whether an unresolved address exists in public DNS

suggestion.reason: Fixes OMP and ACP question forms that showed 2N steps with no question text.

topics.summary: For a single-choice field, an optional <id>__other text field is merged into the same question, and custom text goes to the companion field. Multi-select fields keep both fields.
topics.title: ACP ask forms with a free-text companion field show one step per question

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading Codex error that f5 users on managed accounts can hit. Reimplement in f5's Codex failure mapping.

topics.summary: When an org-managed requirements.toml or cloud policy forbids the approval policy or sandbox mode a thread sends, the user now sees a curated message naming the managed requirement and the field. Before, a generic retry message was shown, and retrying never works.
topics.title: Codex turns refused by a managed access policy say so instead of 'retry'

suggestion.reason: Agents that quote long IDs back get them wrong, which breaks follow-ups to subagents. Reimplement in f5's provider adapters, keeping old IDs working.

topics.summary: Subagent child thread IDs become thread:subagent:<16 hex>, a hash of the old derived ID. Existing subagent threads keep their old IDs, so resumed continuations still land on the same thread.
topics.title: Subagent threads get short IDs agents can quote back

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stale sidebar state for deleted worktrees, which f5 can also hit.

topics.summary: Branch status updates now include isRepo, so sidebar rows can tell a deleted checkout from a detached HEAD and stop showing the saved branch and worktree icon.
topics.title: Sidebar rows drop a branch and worktree that were deleted

suggestion.reason: Prevents data loss in forks after their source thread is deleted.

topics.summary: Attachment cleanup on thread delete skips message attachments, HTML/MCP App/recording items and answer files that a live run fork still shows.
topics.title: Deleting a source thread keeps the attachments its live fork still shows

suggestion.reason: Improves the image viewer for HTML renders, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The bootstrap sends every eligible image on the page plus the clicked image's index, so the viewer can step through all of the page's images.
topics.title: html_render images open with the rest of their page's images in the viewer

suggestion.reason: Fixes PR watches that report watching but never fire. The PR hub is an f5 surface.

topics.summary: The deferred settle skips settling when a linked PR watch started after the settle request, so watch_pull_request calls made later in the same turn are not silently dropped.
topics.title: A PR watch started after a pending self-settle survives the turn end

suggestion.reason: Stops providers from briefly showing as unavailable because of transient probe errors.

topics.summary: A single non-auth failure in a periodic check on a ready provider is held back, and the check runs again after 30 s. Only a second failure is published.
topics.title: One failed status check no longer marks a ready provider unavailable

suggestion.reason: Fixes a reliability problem: the service log grows without limit on hosts that run the background service.

topics.summary: The service launcher reads the log path from the installed systemd unit, launchd plist or Windows task. It checks the file's size at startup and every 10 minutes, and truncates it in place once it passes 10 MiB.
topics.title: Boot service log is emptied in place once it passes 10 MiB
fix(mobile): Android review sheet scrolls to Submit review (#34887)

suggestion.reason: Fixes failed worktree creation, a symptom that can occur in f5's git and worktree subsystem.

topics.summary: `git worktree add` now truncates buffered output instead of failing at the 1 MB cap, and keeps progress line callbacks after truncation. Hooks or filter drivers that print a lot no longer abort worktree creation.
topics.title: New worktrees survive git printing over 1 MB
fix(mobile): iPhone Settings search keeps its query after switching tabs (#34893)

suggestion.reason: Smaller MCP thread reads, and agents can see PR watch state.

topics.summary: The first page of a t3_thread_read lists open linked PRs with watching and watchStartedAt, plus a count. Later pages return only the count.
topics.title: Thread reads list only open linked PRs and show their watch state

suggestion.reason: Stops Codex goals from re-prompting while a delegated task is still running.

topics.summary: When a delegated task's wake is pending at the end of a turn, the Codex goal is paused instead of continuing. The next ordinary turn resumes it.
topics.title: Codex goals wait for a delegated task instead of re-prompting

suggestion.reason: Fixes a timeline follow bug in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: A pointerdown on the scroll node now counts as a scrollbar press only in its trailing 16px or scrollbar lane. Clicking the padding no longer releases follow mode while a reply streams.
topics.title: Clicking the timeline's empty padding keeps following a streaming reply

suggestion.reason: A small reliability and performance fix in project enrichment, which f5 has.

topics.summary: When a project folder has been deleted, the favicon resolver now caches the failure for 1 minute. Before, every enrichment pass looked up and stat'ed the missing folder again. Other failures still get no cache time.
topics.title: Favicon lookups for a missing project folder are cached

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stale 'update available' state for Codex in f5's provider maintenance.

topics.summary: For codex-native installs, the latest version comes from releases.openai.com's channel tag_name instead of npm's @openai/codex@latest. A successful update no longer leaves the provider flagged as behind.
topics.title: Standalone Codex is checked against the native release channel

suggestion.reason: The race can also happen in f5's run execution. Port it by reimplementing in f5's layers, since orchestration-v2 doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: When the first provider turn update arrives, ingestion rechecks under the thread lock whether the run is still running. If Stop already cancelled it, the new provider turn is interrupted instead of left running.
topics.title: Stop interrupts a provider turn that starts while Stop lands

suggestion.reason: Lockfile and dependency hygiene for upstream's Vercel tooling. No user-visible behavior changes.

topics.summary: Adds pnpm overrides that clear security advisories in the @vercel/routing-utils and @vercel/config dependencies.
topics.title: Dependency overrides for path-to-regexp and zod under @vercel packages

suggestion.reason: Keeps delegated work results that f5's delegation surfaces would otherwise lose.

topics.summary: When a delegated run fails after writing an assistant message, the result text includes the error followed by the last assistant message. task_status and completion notices then no longer drop the report.
topics.title: A failed delegated task keeps its child's final report

suggestion.reason: Improves git status performance in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Branch change totals skip untracked input larger than 256 MiB and report that the files are too large to count. Status of a new repository with big untracked files then no longer stalls on git diff --numstat.
topics.title: Git status no longer waits on huge untracked files

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop updater bug that f5 can hit.

topics.summary: If saving the update channel fails, the release floor is restored to the previous track's value. Valid updates on the unchanged track are no longer filtered out.
topics.title: A failed update-track save keeps offering the current track's updates

suggestion.reason: This changes upstream's ContextHandoffBudget system in orchestration-v2, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: For providers with no usage reports, stored history is estimated at bytes/4 tokens. About 100 KB of history no longer looks full and silently replaces the native session on a provider switch.
topics.title: Handoff budget estimates stored history in tokens, not bytes

suggestion.reason: Gives f5's Muse provider an actionable status message.

topics.summary: When `muse --version` fails with 'installed binary is missing', the status tells the user to run `muse --version` on the host and then refresh, instead of a generic 'failed to run'.
topics.title: An unfinished Muse install says how to finish setup

suggestion.reason: Makes SSH remote setup errors clearer, in a remote-launch surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The SSH remote runner adds a message after curl or wget errors that names the version and URL and explains how to install t3 manually with install.sh or a mirror.
topics.title: A failed remote t3 download says what failed and how to install it

suggestion.reason: Fixes dropped thread clicks on desktop, if f5's sidebar uses the same pointer sensor.

topics.summary: A press that hasn't started dragging now treats a buttons=0 pointermove as a normal release, so the row's click still navigates. Desktop builds report buttons=0 just before pointerup, which had dropped single clicks on threads.
topics.title: Sidebar clicks no longer get lost when the release reports no buttons

suggestion.reason: Frees Claude processes earlier, a reliability and resource improvement for f5's delegation.

topics.summary: Once a delegated child's result is recorded and it has no pending background tasks, its provider session is detached right away instead of waiting for the idle timeout. Delegates with running background tasks keep the idle-timer behavior.
topics.title: Finished Claude delegates release their process

suggestion.reason: A small correctness fix for CLI hints that f5 shows.

topics.summary: The host CLI hint keeps a plain `t3` only when PATH's t3 resolves to the running launcher or executable. Otherwise it uses the absolute path, so the command shown runs the same version.
topics.title: Setup hints name the running t3 executable, not another t3 on PATH

suggestion.reason: Fixes custom Claude models being silently replaced. Reimplement in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: When the outgoing model is opus, sonnet, haiku or fable, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_<ALIAS>_MODEL is pinned to the alias itself. The CLI then stops swapping a custom model for its built-in one.
topics.title: Custom Claude models named like a Claude Code alias reach the API unchanged

suggestion.question: Should f5 hide non-GitHub hosts in Add project by default, or keep every host listed?
suggestion.reason: Improves the UX of Add project, but by default it hides hosts that f5 users may rely on.

topics.summary: The project pickers and publish dialogs list only GitHub by default. A per-environment switch in Settings → Source control adds other hosts. Clone by URL and PR features keep working on every host.
topics.title: Add project lists only GitHub until other hosts are turned on

suggestion.reason: Small fix for wrong text in the file preview.

topics.summary: LargeTextViewer uses the singular noun when a count is 1.
topics.title: CSV/TSV and large-text previews say 1 row, 1 column and 1 line

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Cursor provider bug: these skills were never loaded.

topics.summary: For /name skills marked disable-model-invocation, the adapter appends the SKILL.md body to the prompt in a skill block, so Cursor actually loads them.
topics.title: Cursor prompts include user-invoked skills that are hidden from the model

suggestion.reason: Without this, the hint signs the user into the wrong Codex home.

topics.summary: A signed-out Codex instance with its own home path tells the user to run codex login with CODEX_HOME set to that path.
topics.title: Codex sign-in hint names the instance's CODEX_HOME

suggestion.reason: Fork checkouts get the correct repository identity, matching what gh uses.

topics.summary: If exactly one remote is marked gh-resolved base, it becomes the primary remote. Otherwise the order stays upstream, origin, then alphabetical.
topics.title: Project identity follows gh repo set-default

suggestion.reason: Improves timeline status accuracy. Port the web part inside f5's thread state; the mobile part doesn't apply.

topics.summary: A running run with no provider turn yet shows 'Starting <provider>' instead of 'Thinking', so a slow CLI boot or MCP registration isn't shown as generation.
topics.title: The live row says 'Starting Claude' until the provider actually starts

suggestion.reason: Fixes a reliability bug: runs got stuck in starting.

topics.summary: On the last retry, a failed read of the runtime recovery projection settles the run as failed with the error "Couldn't read thread state".
topics.title: A run whose recovery state can't be read fails instead of staying in starting

suggestion.reason: Fixes a git reliability bug that can leave a working tree half updated. f5 keeps its autoPullDefaultBranch default.

topics.summary: git pull --ff-only and the PR head fast-forward or reset no longer have a 30 s timeout, so a slow LFS smudge no longer leaves a half-updated working tree.
topics.title: Automatic pulls and PR checkout refresh let slow checkouts finish

suggestion.reason: Fixes leaked ssh processes after desktop updates.

topics.summary: installDownloadedUpdate runs the SSH manager's closeAllTunnels together with the backend stops before quitAndInstall, so `ssh -N -L` children no longer outlive each update.
topics.title: Installing an update closes SSH port forwards before relaunch

suggestion.reason: Small fix: replaces a confusing error with a clear one.

topics.summary: Above the limit, content search sends no request and says 'Search is limited to 256 characters.' instead of 'Schema validation failed'.
topics.title: Content search over 256 characters explains the limit

suggestion.reason: Fixes an OpenCode provider bug: these pages were neither shown nor cleaned up.

topics.summary: htmlRenderFromToolItem also accepts htmlRender references from OpenCode's execute tool items, so these pages are shown and are deleted with the thread.
topics.title: html_render pages from OpenCode 2 Code Mode show and are cleaned up

suggestion.reason: The fix lives in upstream's orchestration-v2 effect outbox worker, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Each orchestration-v2 EffectWorker daemon loop waits at most 30 s for a claimed effect, then goes back to claiming other work while the slow execution keeps running.
topics.title: One unresponsive provider no longer stalls every thread's effects

suggestion.reason: Prevents silent loss of background work.

topics.summary: Mode, worktree, model and provider changes that would detach a session with background work are refused with a retryable error, instead of killing its subagents and shells.
topics.title: Thread setting changes no longer end a Claude session's background work

suggestion.reason: The bug only happens when a thread runs in a remote environment, and the fix is in client-runtime asset resolution.

topics.summary: Relative Markdown image references are marked hostOnly, and the asset query is scoped to match. Remote-environment threads then don't resolve them against the local desktop's files.
topics.title: Relative Markdown images in a remote thread no longer show the desktop's file

suggestion.reason: Fixes delegated-task waits failing with no task handle to recover from.

topics.summary: Task waits default to 4 minutes, so the call returns taskId with waitTimedOut before Node fetch drops it at 300 s. Other waits keep their 10-minute default.
topics.title: delegate_task wait returns its task handle before Node fetch's 300 s timeout

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop bug: providers and tools go missing after a slow boot because the app keeps launchd's PATH.

topics.summary: A desktop shell-environment probe that times out is now recorded as an error, and that shell is retried once with a 20 s timeout. This matches the server's slow-shell retry, so the app no longer runs all session with launchd's PATH.
topics.title: A login shell slower than 5s at launch still yields its PATH

suggestion.question: Does f5's declined 'Automatic file-link repair' item also cover resolving a chat file link to a file in another project?
suggestion.reason: Improves chat file links. It could overlap with the declined 'Automatic file-link repair'. Only the web part applies.

topics.summary: When a chat file link is not found in the thread's workspace, it falls back to the one other project that has the file. The thread-local path still wins when it exists. The mobile part does not apply.
topics.title: File links the agent cited from another project open that project's file

suggestion.reason: Claude replies arrive only as whole blocks; this restores streaming in the Claude provider.

topics.summary: Root text deltas stream as a running assistant message through the coalescer. The block snapshot corrects the text if needed and isn't emitted twice.
topics.title: Claude replies stream paragraph by paragraph again

suggestion.reason: This fixes upstream's server-side ServerBrowser/Playwright preview. f5 policy says those preview topics don't apply.

topics.summary: ServerBrowser clears Playwright's light prefers-color-scheme emulation after it attaches to a desktop guest over CDP.
topics.title: Desktop browser tabs on System appearance follow the system color scheme

suggestion.reason: f5 has a right panel and a preview browser, so the same overlap can happen. This is a small CSS fix.

topics.summary: The right-panel resize handle's hit area moves inside the panel's left edge and is raised to z-40, above the browser webview layer. It no longer sits on the chat scrollbar lane.
topics.title: Panel resize handle no longer covers the chat scrollbar

suggestion.reason: Small UX improvement on header controls that exist in f5.

topics.summary: Wraps these icon-only controls in tooltips: the Git quick action and options chevron, the Open in primary and editor chevron, and the Script actions chevron.
topics.title: Icon-only chat header controls show their name on hover

suggestion.reason: A desktop bug fix for SnapShot's global shortcut on Linux portals, if f5 ships SnapShot.

topics.summary: When xdg-desktop-portal goes away, the shortcut drops its session and reconnects at once through D-Bus activation, instead of staying in 'Reconnecting…' forever.
topics.title: SnapShot shortcut rebinds after the Linux desktop portal restarts

suggestion.reason: Fixes an OpenCode provider bug where the model picker comes up empty. Reimplement inside f5's OpenCode adapter.

topics.summary: The OpenCode 2 model list request is bounded by its own 5 s timeout, and a timeout counts as 'not listed yet'. The loader then falls back to the last successful catalog instead of reporting an error with no models.
topics.title: A slow OpenCode 2 server start no longer leaves the model list empty

suggestion.reason: Claude /clear can happen in f5 too. Reimplement in f5's Claude adapter, because the upstream change lives in orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: When system/init reports a new session_id after /clear, the adapter records the new native session and stores it on the thread. Reopening the thread resumes the post-clear session instead of the old one or failing with 'No conversation found'.
topics.title: Claude threads resume the session that /clear started

suggestion.reason: Fixes PR creation and lookup from fork clones in the PR and forge flow. Reimplement in f5's git and GitHub layers.

topics.summary: In a fork clone where gh's default repository is the upstream, the head is treated as cross-repository and uses an owner:branch selector, so PR creation and lookup target the right repository.
topics.title: Fork PRs into gh's upstream base use an owner-qualified head

suggestion.reason: Improves reliability and observability: a corrupt database now gives an actionable startup error in f5's persistence layer.

topics.summary: The SQLite client now turns open-time errors into a typed SqlError. Startup recognizes SQLITE_CORRUPT and SQLITE_NOTADB and reports the database path with recovery steps, instead of crashing with an untyped 'file is not a database' error.
topics.title: A damaged state database fails startup with its path and how to recover

suggestion.reason: f5 uses fff-based workspace search. A server-wide freeze from blocking native reads is a real reliability bug.

topics.summary: Each fff file finder runs in its own Node worker thread, so blocking native calls no longer stall the server's event loop. The worker's create handshake ignores Node --watch messages.
topics.title: A slow file read in the search watcher no longer freezes the server
fix(mobile): long thread titles in the @ picker keep their Thread marker (#35062)

suggestion.reason: Fixes SSH environments that stop connecting after the user changes Port in ssh config.

topics.summary: The saved SSH bootstrap target keeps the port the caller gave (null when the field was empty), not the one ssh -G resolved. A later change to Port in ~/.ssh/config is then respected.
topics.title: An ssh config alias keeps following its Port after it changes

suggestion.reason: A UX improvement in a panel f5 has.

topics.summary: The Files panel saves its expanded folders per environment and cwd, and reopens each one once lazy loading lists it. Reentrant restores are coalesced to avoid a stack overflow.
topics.title: Files tree keeps expanded folders across remounts

suggestion.reason: A measurable reduction in forge API calls and refetches in the PR hub.

topics.summary: refreshAfterTurn bumps the global listings epoch only after a push. A plain agent turn no longer invalidates every cached PR listing.
topics.title: A finished turn refreshes only its own project's PR listings

suggestion.reason: Opt-in flags used only by the mobile client. The changes sit in client-runtime and ws, which f5 doesn't share.

topics.summary: Mobile asks for provider catalog digests and status deltas, and calls refreshProviders with omitProviders. The server and client-runtime support exists to shrink the mobile launch payload.
topics.title: Mobile environments send about 85% less data at launch

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible bug in the timeline: drag selections break when you scroll. f5's MessagesTimeline uses the same virtualized list.

topics.summary: Rows covered by the current text selection are added to LegendList's always-render indices. Recycled row containers then no longer move the selection's start onto other messages or drop the rows in between.
topics.title: Chat text selection stays continuous while scrolling

suggestion.reason: A small bug fix in a file f5 has.

topics.summary: turnDiffTree splits paths only on '/', so a POSIX name like back\slash.txt no longer collides with back/slash.txt and opens the wrong diff.
topics.title: File names with a backslash no longer split into folders in the Changes card

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for sends that stall in the composer. Reimplement in f5's command layer, since client-runtime is not here.

topics.summary: message.dispatch gets a 60 s deadline that ends in a thread error and a restored draft. Pressing Enter again during a stalled send shows a 'Still sending your previous message' toast instead of doing nothing.
topics.title: A message the host never answers fails after 60 seconds instead of spinning forever

suggestion.reason: Fixes a git bug: these projects had a null repository identity, which hides features that depend on it.

topics.summary: RepositoryIdentityResolver parses `git remote -v` lines the way git formats them (a tab before the URL, one space before the direction), so URLs containing spaces resolve.
topics.title: A project whose origin URL contains a space gets a repository identity

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing T3 MCP tools on the first OpenCode turn.

topics.summary: On OpenCode versions before 2.2.6, the adapter waits 250 ms after adding a new per-thread MCP server, so the first prompt is built after OpenCode's debounced tool reload.
topics.title: OpenCode 2 threads see T3 Code's MCP tools on their first turn

suggestion.reason: Fixes provider updates targeting the wrong install for Vite+ users.

topics.summary: The maintenance resolver reads the Vite+ shimMode, from VP_HOME or the XDG config. With system_first, it follows PATH past the shim to the install that actually runs.
topics.title: Vite+ system_first shims update the install they actually run

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Codex provider bug that makes every turn fail on some backends. Reimplement in f5's Codex adapter.

topics.summary: Before each turn/start, Codex config/read supplies model_reasoning_summary. The turn sends that value or 'auto' instead of always 'detailed', so Bedrock and other providers that reject detailed no longer fail every turn.
topics.title: Codex turns use the configured reasoning summary instead of forcing detailed

suggestion.reason: A UX improvement in the Diff panel.

topics.summary: A new useCodeViewScrollRestore hook saves the Diff panel's scroll position per scope. On return it restores the position, loading more lazy files until the position is reachable.
topics.title: Diff tab keeps its scroll position across thread switches
fix(mobile): Android composer keeps its cursor after a drag-scroll (#35092)

suggestion.reason: Improves desktop observability and stops orphaned child processes.

topics.summary: An exit with shutdown incomplete, for example after display loss, is logged and traced. On Linux, child processes found through /proc are sent SIGTERM and then SIGKILL. The updater's quit path is excluded.
topics.title: Desktop exits that skip quit are recorded and their child processes stopped

suggestion.reason: Bug fix in provider settings. One bad value can make a provider unavailable in f5 too.

topics.summary: Provider settings fields check typed strings against the field's schema. A rejected value (for example 300k for Claude's autoCompactWindow) stays in the field and is not saved. Before, it broke the whole instance config decode and marked the provider unavailable.
topics.title: An invalid provider setting is refused at its field instead of taking the provider offline

suggestion.reason: Accessibility fix in Settings, which f5 has. The visible layout does not change.

topics.summary: The first and last Settings nav groups get hidden headings ('Preferences' and 'More'). Every role=group then has aria-labelledby, so screen readers announce a group name and heading navigation reaches each group.
topics.title: Every Settings nav group has a name for screen readers

suggestion.reason: Composer and timeline bug fix. A failed send could otherwise leave a stale message row in f5.

topics.summary: A failed send always removes its optimistic row. If the composer already holds a new draft, a persistent 'Copy message' toast keeps the failed text. If the composer is empty, the failed draft is restored.
topics.title: A failed send leaves the timeline even when a new draft was typed
test(web): command palette tests clear a leaked last-used project (#35107)

suggestion.reason: Fixes data loss in client settings and drafts when several windows or tabs are open, which can happen in f5.

topics.summary: Client settings, the prompt stash and composer drafts re-read localStorage or listen to storage events before writing. A save in one tab no longer overwrites another tab's changes with its stale in-memory copy.
topics.title: A save in one tab no longer erases what another tab saved

suggestion.reason: Small display fix in the PR hub, which f5 has.

topics.summary: markdownExcerpt backs off one code unit when the cut would leave a lone high surrogate, so an emoji at the limit no longer renders as '�…'.
topics.title: PR comment hover excerpts no longer end in a replacement character

suggestion.reason: Bug fix in PR hub viewed-file tracking, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Viewed presses send the blob revision that was on screen. The server stores that revision instead of the head at press time, so a later push correctly marks the file Changed.
topics.title: A file ticked Viewed before loading a push shows Changed

suggestion.reason: Observability fix. client-runtime does not exist in f5, so the refresh interval has to be reimplemented on f5's equivalent query.

topics.summary: The process resource history query re-reads every 5 s while Settings > Diagnostics is mounted, like its sibling telemetry history, and stops after unmount.
topics.title: Diagnostics Resource History keeps updating while open

suggestion.reason: Git reliability fix. The same symptom can occur in f5's git layer.

topics.summary: Git child processes unset inherited GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE and related variables. A command can still set them itself. A server started from a Git hook no longer shows one repository's state in every project.
topics.title: Projects read their own Git repository when the server inherited GIT_DIR

suggestion.reason: Prevents losing an in-progress cherry-pick or revert through f5's commit flow.

topics.summary: The selected-files commit guard now checks CHERRY_PICK_HEAD and REVERT_HEAD as well as MERGE_HEAD. It fails with a message naming the operation, instead of resetting the index and losing the in-progress state.
topics.title: Selected-file commits during a cherry-pick or revert are refused

suggestion.reason: Worktree creation bug fix. A leftover folder can block every later worktree for that branch in f5 too.

topics.summary: When the server picks the worktree folder name itself and that folder exists, it adds -2, -3 and so on until a name is free. Explicit caller paths still fail as before when taken.
topics.title: A new worktree no longer fails when its generated folder is left over from an earlier one

suggestion.reason: f5 commits selected files too, so a large selection can fail and leave the Git action stuck. Reimplement in f5's git layer.

topics.summary: Selected paths go to git add on stdin through --pathspec-from-file with NUL separators. Spawn errors thrown synchronously now map to GitCommandError, so the Git button settles instead of hanging after a defect.
topics.title: Committing a large file selection no longer fails with spawn E2BIG

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance gain: upstream saw sends to very long threads take 16 to 32 seconds before this.

topics.summary: The thread read before a message dispatch skips settled tool items, leaf nodes and settled subagents through indexes, and loads only pending context transfers. Adds migration 083.
topics.title: Sending to a very long thread reads about 5x less of its history

suggestion.reason: Stops f5's commit action from silently committing unresolved conflicts. A git correctness fix.

topics.summary: Before git add -A, which marks unmerged paths as resolved, commit runs git diff --check on unmerged paths. It refuses when a file still has both an opening and a closing conflict marker. A lone ======= line is allowed.
topics.title: Commit refuses while a merge still has conflict markers

suggestion.reason: Small correctness fix to PR suggestions in the composer, which f5 has for its forges.

topics.summary: The newest-first tie-break compares Date.parse instants instead of ISO strings. GitLab timestamps with different UTC offsets then sort correctly, and the limit no longer drops a newer request.
topics.title: Composer # suggestions sort by update time, not timestamp text

suggestion.reason: If f5 has scoped browser settings, this fixes a settings-leak bug. The upstream settings files mostly don't exist in f5, so reimplement it.

topics.summary: Browser viewport, zoom, appearance and default-profile settings save through scoped updates, so a change made in project scope stays in that scope. Creating, renaming and removing profiles still write to the primary settings.
topics.title: Browser settings changed in project scope no longer overwrite the global default

topics.reason: Docs only; no change to the product.

suggestion.reason: Docs only; no change to the product.

topics.summary: Rewrites the upstream README with a hero image, a 'What you get' list and a short install table.
topics.title: README refresh with hero image and shorter install guide

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix in a shared shell helper that the fork has. It bounds startup time.

topics.summary: The synchronous login-shell environment probe uses SIGKILL when its 5 s timeout expires. Startup scripts that trap SIGTERM can no longer block server startup.
topics.title: Timed-out login shell probes are force-killed

suggestion.reason: Terminal output silently goes missing. Port if f5's terminal uses the Ghostty core. The upstream files don't exist in the fork, so check first.

topics.summary: The Ghostty core's max_scrollback is measured in bytes, so the 10,000 value kept very little history. It now uses a 10,000,000-byte budget, matching Ghostty's default.
topics.title: Terminal keeps about 10 MB of scrollback instead of about 700 rows

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong terminal identification in f5's integrated terminal. Tools inside the shell can then detect the host correctly.

topics.summary: New terminal shells get TERM_PROGRAM=t3code and TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION set to the server version, instead of inheriting the launcher's identity (for example Apple_Terminal). On Windows, inherited keys are filtered case-insensitively, and explicit overrides still win.
topics.title: Integrated terminal shells report TERM_PROGRAM=t3code
